title: Investor Relations Manager for Fast-Growing Property Investment Business in Australia
description:
Geelong-based property investment and development business. 10+ renovation projects and 40+ investment properties across NSW, Victoria and WA. Deals are funded by money partners - private investors who back our projects.



Investor relations currently sits with the founder. We need someone who owns it.



The role

- Communicate with money partners - project updates, spend to date, projected returns

- Manage contracts and the money side of each deal - loan agreements, drawdowns, interest, payouts, mortgage and caveat discharges

- Maintain spreadsheets tracking who's invested in what, on what terms, and payment due dates

- Work with our lawyer and bookkeeper so every agreement and payment is correct and on time

- Onboard new money partners - explain the process, security, and terms

- Keep an accurate picture of all partner funds across projects and trusts



Requirements

- Strong with numbers and spreadsheets - can build a payout schedule and spot errors

- Strong with contracts - can read a loan agreement and flag issues

- Strong communicator - clear, professional, and honest with investors

- Background in loan administration, fund operations, broking support, conveyancing, or property/lending finance

- Across property finance basics - mortgages, caveats, settlements, discharges



Nice to have

- Property development, private lending, or fund admin experience

- Familiarity with trust structures

- Hours & schedule

- Full-time, immediate start. Available to work in Melbourne business hours (8am-5pm)



How to apply — mandatory requirements

- A 2–3 minute Loom video is required for every applicant — no exceptions. Please speak naturally and unscripted — don't read from a script, we can tell. Introduce yourself, walk through your relevant experience, and explain why this role is a fit for you.



Also include:

- Examples of your experience with loan administration, fund operations, or finance in a property/lending context

- Your availability and earliest start date



Applications without a Loom video will NOT be considered.

title: Executive Assistant  for Business Operations & Growth Support
description:
We're an Australian property investment business launching several new ventures — including an online education platform and a drop-shipping curtain business — alongside our core operations. We're looking for a strong, capable operator who can take true end-to-end ownership: setting up a business from scratch and then running it day-to-day once live.



This is not an admin or support role. You'll be the person who builds how a business works — systems, processes, structure — and then keeps it running well. If one venture doesn't fill your time, you may take on more than one.



This is a full-time role, starting part-time for the first few months.



What you'll be doing

- Setting up new business ventures — it's systems, structure, and operations

- Running ventures day-to-day once they're operational

- Building and managing teams where needed as ventures grow

- Establishing processes so each business operates smoothly without constant oversight

- Identifying and solving operational problems before they become blockers

- Reporting progress and flagging issues that need attention

- Taking on new ventures or projects as they come up — scoping and launching each one

- Bringing structure to ambiguous, early-stage situations



Who we're looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience setting up a business, department, or venture from scratch — not just running an existing one

- Have experience managing or coordinating teams

- Are comfortable operating with real autonomy and minimal day-to-day direction

- Can make sound decisions independently and follow through without being chased

- Communicate clearly and professionally in written and spoken English

- Are a strategic thinker who is also structured and detail-oriented in execution

- Can juggle multiple ventures or priorities at once



Experience in online education, real estate, buyers agency, or ecommerce is a strong plus — but we're primarily looking for a proven operator who can figure things out, regardless of specific industry background.



What success looks like

- New ventures move from idea to fully operational

- Once live, each venture runs smoothly with minimal oversight required

- Problems get identified and solved before they escalate

- You become someone we can hand a new venture to and trust it'll get built and run well



Hours and working arrangement

- Full-time role, starting part-time for the first few months. Some availability during Melbourne business hours required. Exact hours and schedule will be discussed with shortlisted applicants.



How to apply

Please submit the following:

- Your most recent, updated CV

- A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and walking through your relevant experience — please speak naturally, and DO NOT read from a script



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered. Please speak naturally in your video rather than reading from a prepared script.

title: Product Image Collection & Formatting – Pools & Hot Tubs
description:
Sensassion Pool & Spa, a Florida-based pool and hot tub company, is looking for a reliable and detail-oriented freelancer to help us prepare product images for our new website.



We carry multiple brands of fiberglass pools, hot tubs, and swim spas, and we need approximately 550 product images to be collected, sorted, renamed, and formatted.



What You Will Do



We will provide you with:



A complete list of all brands and product models

Access to our manufacturers’ dealer intranets

Links to manufacturer resources when needed

The exact image dimensions and formats required

Clear instructions for file naming and organization



Your job will be to:



Find and download the correct official high-resolution images for each product

Make sure every image matches the exact brand and model

Select the best and most useful images available for each product

Sort and remove duplicate, irrelevant, or low-quality images

Resize and crop the selected images to our required dimensions

Maintain excellent image quality and proportions — no stretched or distorted images

Rename every image according to our naming system

Organize everything into clearly labeled folders by brand and model



For hot tubs and swim spas, we may need several images per model, such as:



Main/lifestyle image

Front view

Interior/top view showing the seats and jets

Side view

Technical or cutaway view when available



For fiberglass pools, we may need:



Main/lifestyle image

Pool shell view

Top view

Technical/dimensional drawing

Additional product views when available

Project Size



Approximately 550 images total.



This is NOT a graphic design project. You will not be creating images from scratch.



The main work is finding the correct images, selecting them, organizing them, resizing/cropping them, and delivering everything in the correct format.



Accuracy is extremely important.



Who We Are Looking For



You should be:



Very detail-oriented

Organized and reliable

Comfortable navigating websites and dealer intranets

Experienced with image resizing and cropping

Comfortable using Photoshop, Canva, or similar software

Able to maintain image quality while formatting images

Able to follow detailed instructions without constant supervision



Experience with e-commerce, product catalogs, website product uploads, pools, spas, or home improvement products is a plus.



Compensation



Fixed-price project: approximately $200



We are open to discussing the final price depending on your experience and estimated completion time.



There may also be additional ongoing work for the right person after this project.



How to Apply



Please start your application with the word “POOL” so we know you read the entire job post.



Then tell us:



What experience you have with similar image or product catalog projects

Which software you use for image resizing/editing

How long you estimate it would take you to complete approximately 550 images

Your fixed-price quote for the complete project

Please provide an example of similar work if available



Please do not apply if you cannot carefully verify that each image corresponds to the exact product model.



We are looking for someone who is fast, accurate, organized, and reliable.

title: SOLAR Sales Closer / Appointment Setter (Remote – Full Time PST)
description:
About Solar Flare INC



Solar Flare INC is a licensed, insured, and certified solar installation, maintenance, and repair company headquartered in Indio, California. We proudly serve homeowners and commercial clients throughout the Coachella Valley, Riverside County, and Southern California.



As certified installers for Tesla, Enphase, and Franklin, we specialize in residential and commercial solar systems, battery storage, EV charger installations, and Main Service Panel (MSP) upgrades. Our reputation is built on quality workmanship, honest communication, and exceptional customer service.



As demand continues to grow, we're looking for an experienced Sales Closer / Appointment Setter who can convert qualified leads into scheduled consultations and signed contracts.



?? MANDATORY REQUIREMENT — AURORA SOLAR EXPERIENCE



Hands-on experience using Aurora Solar is REQUIRED and NON-NEGOTIABLE.



Applicants must have prior professional experience using Aurora Solar software. This is not an entry-level position where Aurora Solar can be learned after hiring.



Candidates should be comfortable navigating Aurora Solar and understanding solar designs, system layouts, production estimates, proposals, and other relevant solar project information.



Applications from candidates without prior Aurora Solar experience will not be considered.



*The Opportunity



This is NOT a cold-calling role.



We generate leads through our marketing efforts, referrals, and inbound inquiries. Your responsibility is to respond quickly, build rapport, qualify each prospect, schedule appointments for our sales team, and close qualified opportunities directly when appropriate.



You'll be working with homeowners and businesses interested in:



Residential and commercial solar systems

Tesla Powerwall and battery storage

EV charger installations

Main Service Panel (MSP) upgrades

Solar maintenance, repairs, and inspections



We're looking for someone who understands that speed, persistence, and consistent follow-up win sales. If you know how to build trust, overcome objections, and keep opportunities moving forward, you'll thrive in this role.



*What You'll Do



Respond promptly to inbound leads via phone, text,
, and CRM.

Qualify homeowners based on their needs, property, timeline, budget, and project goals.

Use Aurora Solar to review and understand solar designs, proposals, system information, and project details.

Schedule qualified appointments promptly with our sales consultants.

Close qualified opportunities directly when appropriate.

Follow up consistently with prospects who have not yet made a decision.

Build rapport and maintain a professional customer experience throughout the sales process.

Answer questions about our solar and home-improvement services and guide customers toward appropriate solutions.

Confidently explain basic solar concepts, system proposals, and project details to prospective customers.

Update all lead activity, notes, and follow-up tasks accurately in our CRM.

Coordinate with our operations team after a sale to ensure a smooth customer handoff.

Meet or exceed appointment-setting, conversion, and sales goals.

Maintain consistent communication with prospects throughout the sales cycle.

Who We're Looking For



We want someone who genuinely enjoys talking with people, understands the solar industry, and isn't afraid to ask for the sale.



The ideal candidate:



Has professional hands-on experience with Aurora Solar — REQUIRED.

Has previous experience as an appointment setter, inside sales representative, solar sales representative, or closer.

Has a strong understanding of residential solar and the overall solar sales process.

Is confident handling objections and moving conversations forward.

Understands the importance of immediate follow-up and persistence.

Can manage multiple leads without allowing opportunities to fall through the cracks.

Is organized, self-motivated, accountable, and results-driven.

Communicates professionally and confidently with homeowners.

Is comfortable discussing solar proposals, system designs, and project information.

Can work independently while maintaining consistent communication and productivity.



*Requirements



*Required — Non-Negotiable



Prior professional experience using Aurora Solar software.

Applicants without Aurora Solar experience will NOT be considered.

Proven experience in appointment setting, inside sales, solar sales, or closing.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Strong understanding of the residential solar sales process.

Comfortable using CRM systems to manage leads, notes, appointments, and follow-ups.

Must be available during Pacific Time business hours, approximately 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PT, Monday through Friday.

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional workspace.

Ability to work independently while consistently meeting performance goals.

Preferred



Experience in solar, roofing, HVAC, home improvement, or other home-service industries is strongly preferred.



Compensation

Competitive base pay plus commission.

Performance bonuses based on appointments set, deals closed, and overall sales performance.

Significant earning potential for high performers.

Long-term career growth with a rapidly expanding company.



Compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated performance.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



Your updated resume.

A brief cover letter explaining why you're a good fit for the position.

A 1–2 minute voice or video introduction describing your sales, appointment-setting, and Aurora Solar experience.



Please specifically include your level of Aurora Solar experience in your application.



Applications missing any of the required materials or lacking prior Aurora Solar experience will not be considered.



We're hiring immediately and will be interviewing qualified candidates on a rolling basis.

title: Amazon/TikTok Shop Customer Service and Account Health Specialist
description:
We are hiring a detail-oriented **Customer Service and Account Health Specialist** to manage customer concerns and account performance across **Amazon Seller Central or TikTok Shop**.



## Responsibilities



* Respond to customer messages professionally and on time

* Resolve order, shipping, cancellation, return, refund, and replacement issues

* Monitor Amazon and TikTok Shop account-health dashboards

We are a U.S.-based accounting and advisory firm looking for an exceptionally strong Senior Accountant and Financial Analyst.

mbers, preparing accurate financial statements, analyzing accounting data, and helping business owners understand what their financial information means.



This is not a basic bookkeeping or transaction-categorization position. We need someone who can independently handle the accounting records of multi-million-dollar companies, identify serious bookkeeping and financial-reporting problems, correct the records, analyze business performance, and provide meaningful financial recommendations.



The ideal candidate must be highly proficient in U.S. GAAP, QuickBooks, Xero, Microsoft Excel, accounting-data analysis, budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow analysis, and management reporting.



Primary Responsibilities



Accounting Cleanup and Review



Review existing bookkeeping for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with U.S. GAAP.

Perform complex QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, and accounting-system cleanups.

Review bookkeeping completed by other accountants and bookkeepers.

Analyze the general ledger, trial balance, balance sheet, profit and loss statement, and supporting schedules.

Identify incorrect classifications, duplicate transactions, missing transactions, unsupported balances, and reconciliation problems.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, merchant processors, payroll accounts, clearing accounts, and intercompany balances.

Correct accounts receivable and accounts payable discrepancies.

Review and correct undeposited funds, suspense accounts, opening balance equity, retained earnings, owner equity, and uncategorized transactions.

Review payroll expenses, payroll liabilities, sales-tax liabilities, loan balances, fixed assets, accumulated depreciation, prepaid expenses, deferred revenue, accruals, and other balance-sheet accounts.

Prepare and post adjusting journal entries.

Manage month-end and year-end closing procedures.

Maintain supporting schedules, reconciliation workpapers, cleanup logs, and complete audit trails.



Excel and Accounting Data Analysis



Use advanced Microsoft Excel to organize, clean, analyze, and reconcile large accounting datasets.

Combine data from QuickBooks, Xero, banks, payroll systems, merchant processors, and other platforms.

Analyze general-ledger and transaction-level data to identify errors, duplicates, unusual activity, missing information, and financial trends.

Use PivotTables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, IF formulas, dynamic arrays, data validation, conditional formatting, and other advanced Excel functions.

Build repeatable Excel models and templates for accounting reconciliations and financial analysis.

Perform data cleanup, account mapping, transaction matching, variance analysis, and trend analysis.

Create dashboards, charts, schedules, and management reports that clearly explain financial performance.

Validate the completeness and accuracy of imported or exported accounting data.

Work efficiently with large data files containing thousands of transactions.



Budgeting and Forecasting



Prepare annual operating budgets based on historical results and management assumptions.

Create monthly, quarterly, and annual financial forecasts.

Develop rolling 12-month forecasts.

Prepare revenue, expense, payroll, capital-expenditure, and working-capital projections.

Compare actual results against budgets and forecasts.

Investigate and explain significant budget-to-actual variances.

Update forecasts based on current financial performance and changing business conditions.

Build scenario models showing best-case, expected-case, and worst-case results.

Help management understand the financial impact of hiring, pricing, expansion, financing, and other business decisions.



Cash-Flow Analysis



Prepare direct and indirect cash-flow analyses.

Develop weekly and monthly cash-flow forecasts.

Create rolling 13-week cash-flow models.

Analyze expected customer collections, vendor payments, payroll obligations, loan payments, taxes, and other cash requirements.

Identify potential cash shortages before they occur.

Analyze working-capital trends, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, and operating cash requirements.

Recommend ways to improve cash flow, collections, payment timing, and working-capital management.

Monitor actual cash activity against forecasted cash flow and explain major differences.



Financial Reporting and Business Recommendations



Prepare accurate balance sheets, income statements, cash-flow statements, and management reports.

Develop monthly financial-reporting packages for business owners and management.

Analyze revenue growth, gross profit, operating expenses, margins, customer concentration, and profitability.

Identify unusual financial trends, declining margins, increasing costs, or potential operational problems.

Calculate and analyze financial and operational key performance indicators.

Review profitability by customer, product, location, department, class, or service line.

Translate bookkeeping information into clear business insights.

Make practical recommendations based on financial results.

Identify areas where the company may be overspending, underpricing, losing money, or using cash inefficiently.

Recommend improvements to accounting procedures, internal controls, reporting, and financial management.

Clearly explain financial information to business owners who may not have an accounting background.



Required Qualifications



Master’s degree in Accounting

CPA License

At least 10 years of professional accounting, financial-analysis, or full-cycle bookkeeping experience.

At least five years of experience working directly with U.S.-based businesses or U.S. accounting firms.

Significant hands-on experience with complex bookkeeping cleanup and catch-up projects.

Experience reviewing the bookkeeping work of other accountants or bookkeepers.

Advanced knowledge of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, adjusting journal entries, and financial-statement preparation.

Advanced QuickBooks Online experience.

Strong QuickBooks Desktop and Xero experience.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience analyzing large accounting datasets.

Experience creating budgets, forecasts, cash-flow projections, and financial models.

Ability to analyze business performance and provide meaningful financial recommendations.

Strong understanding of balance-sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules.

Ability to independently investigate accounting discrepancies.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong professional judgment, critical-thinking ability, and attention to detail.

Ability to communicate complex accounting and financial information clearly.

Ability to manage multiple clients and meet deadlines without sacrificing accuracy.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, backup internet connection, and backup power solution.

Willingness to follow strict confidentiality, cybersecurity, and data-protection procedures.

Be able to work US Eastern Standard Time schedule





What Success Looks Like



A successful candidate will be able to:



Take over disorganized books and determine what is wrong without requiring step-by-step instructions.

Develop and execute a complete accounting-cleanup plan.

Produce reconciled and properly supported balance-sheet accounts.

Prepare a reliable trial balance and accurate financial statements.

s, and meetings.

title: Content Operations & Affiliate Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:
# Virtual Assistant – Social Media, Affiliate Marketing & Content Operations



**Rate:** $5 USD/hour

**Schedule:** Part-time to start, with opportunity for increased hours and responsibilities



## About the Role



I am a full-time social media content creator creating product-focused content primarily for TikTok, with content also distributed across Instagram,
, YouTube and Amazon.



I am looking for a highly organized, analytical, tech-savvy and proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage the operational side of my content business.



My content is primarily targeted toward women ages 30–50 and focuses heavily on beauty, wellness, supplements, aging and common concerns women experience as they get older. How familiar are you with this audience, and what do you think is important when creating or analyzing content for them?



**This is not a basic data-entry VA position.**



I am looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out, learning new software, analyzing data, researching solutions and improving systems.



You do NOT need to already know every platform listed below. I care more about your ability to learn quickly, research independently, pay close attention to details and solve problems without needing constant step-by-step instructions.



The role will start with the highest-priority responsibilities and expand over time as you learn the business.



## Initial Responsibilities



Your first priorities will include:



* Managing and organizing automation workflow from tiktok to meta/Youtube so viewers receive the correct product/affiliate links

* Comparing affiliate options to identify the best available links and commission opportunities

* Managing and organizing Levanta affiliate links

* Maintaining and organizing my Amazon Storefront

* Checking Amazon Creator Connections for relevant campaigns

* Uploading and submitting applicable content through Trybe

* Monitoring 
 workflows and identifying failed posts or disconnected accounts

* Creating and maintaining a master product and affiliate database

* Testing links and automations to make sure everything is working correctly

* Researching ways to improve workflows, reduce unnecessary steps and increase conversions



## Content Research & Analytics



As you become familiar with the business, a major part of this role will involve helping me understand **why certain content performs better than other content.**



You will analyze my existing social media content and performance data to identify patterns among my highest-viewed and highest-converting videos.



This may include analyzing:



* Spoken hooks and opening lines

* On-screen text hooks

* Video formats and structures

* Views, engagement, clicks, conversions and sales

* Filming locations and backgrounds

* Clothing colors/styles

* Hair up vs. down

* Lighting and camera setup

* Video length

* Green-screen vs. direct-to-camera content

* Calls to action

* Other recurring creative or visual patterns



I want someone who can look beyond the numbers and identify actionable trends.



For example, instead of simply telling me which five videos received the most views, I want you to be able to analyze those videos and ask:



**What do these videos have in common, and how can we use that information to make future content perform better?**



You will also help:



* Research products and social media trends

* Study high-performing competitor content

* Identify successful hooks, formats and content structures

* Research movie, TV, podcast, interview and news clips that could be used as hooks or educational support in my videos

* Organize a searchable library of clips, overlays and creative assets

* Provide data-backed recommendations for future content



## Future Responsibilities



As trust is established and you become familiar with my systems, responsibilities may expand to include:



* Preparing edited videos for posting

* Optimizing repurposed content for Instagram,
 and YouTube

* Creating TikTok carousel/slideshow content

* Monitoring a dedicated brand partnership inbox

* Tracking sponsorship and brand opportunities

* Organizing brand contacts and follow-ups

* Identifying brands that may be worth proactively pitching



I will retain final approval over publishing content, accepting brand partnerships, negotiating rates and other major business decisions.



## Who I'm Looking For



You may be a great fit if you are:



* Extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Analytical and comfortable working with data

* Very comfortable with Google Sheets or Excel

* Tech-savvy and able to learn new software quickly

* Resourceful and good at researching solutions independently

* Familiar with social media, especially TikTok and Instagram

* Able to recognize patterns in content and performance data

* Interested in social media trends, hooks and consumer behavior

* Comfortable troubleshooting when something isn't working

* Proactive rather than waiting for detailed instructions for every task

* A strong written communicator

* Reliable and consistent

* Trustworthy with confidential business information



Experience with affiliate marketing, creator businesses, ManyChat, Amazon Creator Connections, Levanta, TikTok, Meta, YouTube, 
 or similar platforms is a plus, but experience with every platform is **not required**.



## What Matters Most to Me



I do not expect you to know everything on Day 1.



I do expect you to be someone who, when you encounter something you don't know, thinks:



**"Let me research this and figure out the best solution."**



I am looking for someone who can eventually become a trusted part of my business and take ownership of systems rather than simply completing individual tasks.



There is opportunity for increased responsibilities, hours and compensation for the right person.



# HOW TO APPLY



Please answer **all of the questions below** in your application.



Applications that do not answer the questions will not be considered.



### 1. Tell me about your experience as a Virtual Assistant or working with social media/content creators.



Please be specific about what you were responsible for.



### 2. Which of the following platforms have you personally used?



ManyChat, TikTok, Instagram/Meta, YouTube, Amazon Associates/Amazon Influencer, Amazon Creator Connections, Levanta, Trybe, 
, Google Sheets/Excel.



For each platform you have used, briefly explain what you did with it.



**Please do not claim experience with a platform you have only heard of. It is completely okay if you have not used all of them.**



### 3. Rate your Google Sheets/Excel skills from 1–10.



Then give me an example of something you have built or analyzed using a spreadsheet.



### 4. Imagine I have promoted the same product in 15 different videos.



Some videos received very high views but few sales. Other videos received fewer views but generated significantly more sales.



**How would you analyze those 15 videos to figure out what might be causing the difference?**



Please explain what data and creative variables you would compare.



### 5. Imagine I ask you to set up an automation in a software program you have never used before.



You search Google but cannot immediately find instructions for exactly what I am asking you to do.



**What would you do next?**



Please walk me through your process.



### 6. Imagine you discover that I am currently using an Amazon affiliate link that pays a lower commission than another affiliate program for the same product.



What information would you compare before d
 whether we should switch links?

title: Phone Closer - US Dental Patients - $1,200-$1,600/mo + Bonus - Night Shift - 10 Apply Points
description:
FULL-ARCH CALL CLOSER



GnA Consulting · The Conversion Lab · Remote



Salary. $1,200 to $1,600 per month, paid on the 1st and the 15th, every time. Plus $25 to $50 for every consultation that shows up and starts. Where you land in the band depends on what we hear in your recording, not on your resume. A closer who converts clears the top of it.



Schedule. 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday. This is a night shift and your whole schedule inverts. If that doesn't work for your household, please don't apply.



Volume. You'll be on the phone for most of your shift, between new inquiries and follow-up with people who haven't scheduled yet.



ABOUT THE WORK



We work with dental practices in the United States. You'll be the first human a patient talks to after they raise their hand about full-arch implant treatment.



These are not small decisions. Most of the people you call have struggled with their teeth for years. They're embarrassed. 



They're scared of the procedure. They've been quoted a number that frightened them. Some have already sat in another office and walked out.



Your job is to understand the person behind the inquiry, find what's actually in the way, and help the ones who should move forward commit to showing up.



This is not a call center seat and it is not a script. We train frameworks, not lines. You'll have to listen, think and lead the conversation in real time.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Call people who've asked about full-arch implant treatment, and build trust on the first call

• Ask real discovery questions and find what's actually driving the inquiry

• Read emotional cues and change your approach when the person needs something different

• Handle fear, embarrassment and money without flinching and without pushing

• Talk about financing and monthly payments with confidence

• Book the consultation, then build enough commitment that they actually show

• Follow up by phone, text and
 with the people who aren't ready yet

• Keep clean CRM notes. Every call, every time.

• Sit in weekly call reviews and role-play, and put the coaching into the next call



WHAT WE'RE ACTUALLY HIRING FOR



Three things, and we test all three before we ever get on a call with you.



Empathy. You can connect with what somebody is going through. You don't say "I'm sorry to hear that" and move to the next question.



Emotional intelligence. You know when to slow down, when to be quiet, when to reassure, and when to stop asking and start leading.



Critical thinking. You can take everything a patient just gave you, work out what's really in the way, and d
 what to do next without a script telling you.



WHAT SUCCESS SOUNDS LIKE



You can take a call with someone who says "I can't afford this," or "I've already been somewhere else," or "I need to talk to my spouse," or "I'm scared of going through the procedure," or "I've been embarrassed about my teeth for years," and you know each one is a different conversation.



WHAT WE REQUIRE



Real time in a sales seat. You've handled objections and carried a number. High-ticket, healthcare or consultative selling is a plus. The instinct matters more than the industry.



Near-native spoken English. Clear and neutral. You can command a call in English the way you could in your first language. We assess this from your recording, not your resume.



A quiet workspace, a headset and a stable wired connection. Mobile data and pocket WiFi won't work for this role.



Coachability. We record calls and review the hard ones together every week. If that sounds like a problem, this isn't the seat.



Dental experience is preferred and not required. We'd rather train someone with exceptional communication, empathy and judgment than hire someone who knows dental words.



THIS IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF

• You need to read a script word for word

• You get lost when a conversation doesn't follow the expected path

• Talking about money makes you uncomfortable

• You go passive the moment someone objects

• You think the job is done when the appointment is booked



HOW TO APPLY

Four steps. Read all four. Applications that skip a step aren't reviewed.



STEP 1. Record ONE voice recording. One take. Here is exactly what goes in it.



Go to 
. It's free, it needs no account, and it works on a phone. Press record once and do the whole thing in a single take.



Part 1, about 15 seconds. Say your first name, the city you live in, and what time you'd be starting your shift. Just talk. Don't write this down first and don't read it.

Part 2, the three patients below. Say the words "Scenario A" out loud, then respond to the first one. Pause two seconds. "Scenario B," respond. Pause. "Scenario C," respond. Saying the labels is how we find your answers.



For each one, the patient is on the line right now and it's your turn to speak. Don't describe what you would say. Say it, out loud, to them.

Scenario A.  The patient says: "I haven't smiled in a photo in nine years. My daughter's getting married in June and I don't want to be in the pictures like this."

Scenario B.  The patient says: "The other place quoted me $52,000 and my insurance told me they won't cover any of it. I'm 61 years old. I don't know what you expect me to do with that."

Scenario C.  The patient says: "These dentures have been killing me for eight years and I'm done. What's the soonest you can get me in?"



Length. Two to three minutes total. Four at the absolute most. Longer is not better.



No script and no AI. AI will hand you polished wording and take away your voice, and your voice is the entire thing we're listening for. We can hear the difference and it's an automatic no. There are no perfect answers here.



Then check your link before you send it. After you save the recording, copy the Vocaroo link, open it in a private or incognito window, and make sure it plays. A link we can't open is the same as no application. Paste the working link on the first line of your application.



STEP 2. Answer this one question in writing.

Be specific. Short or generic answers don't move forward.

At your highest-volume phone job: how many dials a day, how many real conversations, and what did you do in the ten seconds right after someone hung up on you?



STEP 3. Use 10 Apply Points on this application.



STEP 4. Start your application with the words FULL ARCH, so we know you read to the end.



We reply to everyone who completes all four steps.

title: Graphic Designer for Hairdressing Education Brand (Skool Cover + Meta Ad Creative
description:
Who we are

We're The Hairdresser Secrets — an online education community for professional hairdressers, run by David Murray, a Hall of Fame Irish hairdresser with nearly forty years behind the chair and shows at the Royal Albert Hall.



Our members are working stylists, most of them ten to thirty years into their careers. They already have busy columns and happy clients. What they don't have is certainty — there's always a cut they quietly avoid. We break down every technique on real clients and explain the reasoning behind every section, so they stop guessing.



We run paid Meta ads to grow the community and we're scaling that spend. Right now the design work is being done by the owner between other jobs. That stops when we hire you.



What you'll do



1. Rebuild our Skool cover image. This is your first job and it d
 whether we continue. Our current cover is a warm photographic banner with a decorative gold serif. It looks fine at full size and disappears at thumbnail size. We want the flat, high-contrast style that the top Skool groups use: solid off-white background, heavy sans-serif in near-black, one accent colour on one line, a cut-out photo of David flush to the right edge, and a lot of empty space. Look at the covers on the Skool Discovery page and you'll know exactly what we mean.



2. Meta ad creative. Around 8–12 static image ads a month — usually 2–3 concepts with 4 hook variants each. We give you the headline; you make it stop the scroll.



3. First-frame cards and thumbnails for our video ads. We film in the salon. You cut the still, add the hook text, keep it inside the safe zones.



4. Lesson thumbnails for our classroom. Around 4 a week as we publish. Consistent template, readable at small sizes, so the library looks like one thing rather than twenty.



5. Keep the brand tidy. One set of fonts, one palette, one template file we can hand to the next person. Files named properly and filed where we can find them.



What success looks like in your first 90 days



We measure this role on five things and we'll show you the numbers:



A cover we actually publish, inside the first two weeks.

8–12 ad statics delivered per month, on time.

80% of your work goes out with zero changes from us.

Brief in → first draft back within 48 hours, 9 times out of 10.

At least one of your ad creatives beats our current best performer on cost per sign-up.



Hit all five at day 90 and your rate goes up automatically. We'd rather pay you more than start again.



You must have

2+ years designing social and paid ad creative for brands. Wedding albums, logo packs and print work don't count for this role.

A portfolio of ad creative or thumbnails you personally designed, with performance numbers you can talk about.

Strong Figma or Photoshop. Canva alone is not enough.

Clean cut-outs — hair especially. Our whole business is hair, so a bad edge around someone's head is disqualifying.

Real typographic ability. Most of this job is making four words look expensive.

Good written English. Irish/UK spelling — "colour", not "color". € not $.

2–3 hours of overlap with Irish working hours, Monday to Friday. The rest of your time is yours.

Big plus (not required)

You've designed for a Skool community, a course or a coaching brand before.

You understand hook testing and have made variant sets for paid traffic.

Basic motion — animated text cards, simple lower thirds.

You bring your own concepts instead of waiting for a brief.

What this job is not

You will never hold a camera. We shoot everything in the salon; you design.

You are not running our marketing. We d
 what gets made and what it says. You d
 how it looks and how fast it lands.

This is not one project then silence. It's a steady, long-term, every-week role. We want someone still here in three years.

title: Case Manager - Lemon Law
description:
Summary

**Remote | California Lemon Law Firm | Full-Time

 

** We are a California law firm focused on lemon law and consumer protection litigation, and we are looking for a licensed attorney to join our team as a Case Manager. 

 

This is a hands-on position for an attorney who can manage cases, communicate directly with clients, stay on top of deadlines, and move cases forward from intake through settlement. 

 

## What You’ll Do 

* Manage an assigned caseload from intake/retainer through settlement or resolution. 

* Communicate directly with clients, provide case updates, answer routine questions, and maintain strong client relationships. 

* Request, review, and organize documents and evidence from clients. 

* Review purchase documents, repair orders, warranty records, service history, manufacturer communications, and other case-related documents. 

* Analyze case facts and identify missing information, potential issues, and case strengths/weaknesses. 

* Draft legal documents, including pleadings, discovery, meet-and-confer correspondence, declarations, motions, settlement documents, and other case-related correspondence. 

* Prepare and file documents with the court and assist with e-filing as needed. 

* Track case deadlines, hearings, discovery obligations, settlement deadlines, and other important dates. 

* Coordinate with attorneys, paralegals, case managers, and other members of the team. 

* Maintain accurate and organized case files and case-management records. 

* Follow cases closely and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. 

* Escalate significant legal or case issues when attorney review or strategy decisions are needed. 

 

## What We’re Looking For **Required:** 

 

* An active attorney license in good standing. 

* Experience handling lemon law cases OR civil litigation. 

* Strong legal writing and analytical skills. 

* Excellent communication and client-management skills. 

* Ability to independently manage multiple cases and competing deadlines. 

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment. 

* Professional, responsive, and comfortable communicating directly with clients. 

 

## Preferred 

* Direct California lemon law experience. 

* Experience handling cases from intake through settlement. 

* Experience with pleadings, discovery, motions, settlement negotiations, and court filings. 

* Experience using case-management software such as Filevine. 

* Experience working in a remote law-firm environment. 

 

## The Ideal Candidate 

We are looking for someone who can own their cases rather than simply complete individual assignments. You should be comfortable communicating with clients, reviewing documents, drafting legal work, managing deadlines, coordinating with the team, and keeping a case moving without needing to be reminded about every next step. If you have lemon law experience, that's a strong advantage. If you have solid civil litigation experience and can learn the firm's lemon law process, we are also interested in speaking with you. 

 

## How to Apply 

 

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction explaining your relevant lemon law or civil litigation experience. 

 

### Important 

Read Before Applying To confirm that you have read the entire job posting, include the title and author of the latest book you've read in the subject line of your application. Applications that do not include the code word may not be considered.

title: YouTube Analytics &  Optimization VA
description:
Company Overview

A growing luxury lifestyle YouTube channel focused on high quality watch reviews, strap showcases,

buying guides, and product breakdowns for watch enthusiasts. The channel emphasizes clean visuals,

polished editing, and a refined tone suitable for viewers interested in high end or unique timepieces.

Role Overview

This role supports the Watch Piece Unique channel by owning analytics review, title and thumbnail

optimization, and performance testing. Working alongside the channel's video editor, this person

ensures every upload is set up to perform, using data to guide decisions on titles, thumbnails, and

content strategy. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail oriented, and comfortable translating numbers

into clear, actionable recommendations.

This is a remote, part time role with room to expand as the channel grows.

Key Responsibilities

1. Analytics Monitoring and Reporting

• Review YouTube Studio analytics regularly, including CTR, average view duration, retention

curves, impressions, and traffic sources.

•

Identify trends, drop-off points, and outlier performance across uploads.

• Provide simple, digestible performance summaries and flag videos that need attention.

2. Title and Thumbnail Optimization

• Audit existing video titles and thumbnails against performance data.

• A/B test title and thumbnail variations to improve CTR without sacrificing the channel's premium

tone.

• Research competitor channels and category benchmarks for what's working in the watch/luxury

lifestyle space.

• Collaborate with the editor on thumbnail concepts, text placement, and visual hierarchy grounded in

what the data shows.

3. Metadata and Discoverability

• Recommend tags, descriptions, and keyword strategy to support search and suggested traffic.

• Support chapter, playlist, and end screen structuring to improve session watch time.

4. Strategy Support



• Suggest content or series ideas backed by what audience data shows resonates.

• Track goals and deliverables tied to channel growth (subscribers, watch time, CTR benchmarks).

• Communicate findings clearly to guide upload decisions before publishing.

Qualifications and Skills

• Proven experience with YouTube Studio analytics and channel growth strategy.

• Strong understanding of thumbnail and title testing best practices, including A/B testing tools and

CTR benchmarks.

• Comfortable working independently and communicating findings clearly and concisely.

• Detail oriented, organized, and proactive about flagging issues or opportunities.

• Reliable availability during CST business hours for light collaboration with the editor.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with luxury watches, collecting, or lifestyle/product content.

• Experience with tools like TubeBuddy, VidIQ, or similar.

• Basic understanding of short form platform algorithms (Shorts, TikTok, Reels).

description:

Type: Part Time | 40 hours/week Salary: $7.00/hour USD (approx. $610/month) Schedule: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday Hours: 10:00am to 2:00pm US Mountain Time (12:00am to 4:00am Philippine Time)



Job: 



You will own our listings. That means building, launching, and maintaining property listings across  Furnished Finder, and
 (Marketplace and rental groups) for our vacation rental and mid-term rental inventory.



This is a detail job. A wrong bed count, a stale minimum-stay rule, a photo attached to the wrong unit, or a price that did not carry across platforms costs us real money. If you are the kind of person who double checks their own work before anyone asks, you will do well here.



What You Will Do

Build new listings from scratch on Furnished Finder, 
 and
 using photos, amenity lists, and property details we provide

Write clear, accurate listing descriptions that reflect what is actually at the property

Keep listing details synced across all platforms when something changes (rates, minimum stay, amenities, house rules, availability)

Monitor and respond to Furnished Finder housing requests and
 inquiries during your shift

Maintain a listing audit log so we always know when each listing was last reviewed

Flag discrepancies you find instead of guessing or filling in blanks on your own

Requirements



Non-negotiable:



Hands-on Furnished Finder experience. You have personally built and managed listings on the platform and know how housing requests, listing renewals, and traveler communication work. We are not training anyone on Furnished Finder.

Experience creating and managing vacation rental listings

Experience posting rentals to
 Marketplace and
 rental groups

Excellent written and verbal English. Listings and guest messages go out under our company name.

Available every scheduled shift during the exact hours listed above

Reliable internet and a backup plan when power or connection drops. 



Also important:



Extremely detail oriented. This is the single most important trait for this role.

Able to handle the chaos of a fast paced environment. 



Pay and Growth



$7.00/hour to start, paid twice monthly. We review pay at 90 days and again at one year. Strong performers on our team have grown into larger roles with more pay and more responsibility.



How to Apply



Applications that skip any step below will not be reviewed. This is the first test of whether you read carefully.

Walk me through exactly what you do when a housing request comes in on Furnished Finder.

Name two pieces of information a Furnished Finder listing requires that an Airbnb listing does not.

What is the current annual cost of a Furnished Finder listing, and what does it include?



Send links to a live listings you personally built. Preferrably on Furnished Finder.



In one sentence, tell me about a time you caught a mistake in a listing before it went live.



Confirm you can work
Mountain Standard Time? (you won't work that long of a shift, but the shifts rotate through and those are the hours that you will have to work.) 

Are you able to work weekends?

title: FACEBOOK ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATION/EDITING
description:
FACEBOOK ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATION/EDITING



We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.

We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.

This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide





Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)





 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases





UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly





Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action





Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof





VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure





Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.

You should know how to make videos that:

Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds





Make the problem feel real and urgent





Show the product clearly and persuasively





Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention





Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok





Communicate benefits quickly and clearly





Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof





Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase





You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.

THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands





Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them





Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative





Can create multiple ad variations quickly





Know how to follow references without copying them blindly





Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow





Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused





Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast





Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good





We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation





ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover





Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video





At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use





you also have experience with:

Meta/Facebook ad creatives





Short-form paid social videos





Long-form VSLs or sales videos





Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing





Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools





Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen





Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts





Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield





Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs





Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references





Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles





Creating variations of winning ads for further testing





Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs





Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios





Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized





Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance





Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations





WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience





Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives





The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue





Clear creative direction and fast feedback





Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time





We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: HOA Accountant (Vantaca)
description:
Location: Work from Home

Type of Employment: Full-time

Work Shift: US Business Hours



About the Role

We are seeking an experienced HOA Accountant with strong Vantaca expertise to manage financial operations for multiple homeowners associations. This role focuses on maintaining accurate financial records, performing reconciliations, handling assessments, and preparing financial reports in compliance with HOA standards.



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and experienced in managing HOA financials within Vantaca, including owner ledgers, payables, receivables, and reporting.



Key Responsibilities

HOA Accounting & Financial Management

Manage HOA financials using Vantaca, including owner ledgers and association accounts.

Record and track assessments, payments, special assessments, and adjustments.

Process accounts payable, including vendor invoices and approvals.

Maintain accurate financial records for multiple HOA communities.



Reconciliation & Reporting

Perform monthly bank and balance sheet reconciliations.

Prepare financial statements including balance sheets, income statements, and budget vs. actual reports.

Generate board-ready financial packages and homeowner statements.

Support month-end and year-end closing processes.



Accounts Receivable & Collections

Monitor delinquent accounts and assist with collections tracking.

Coordinate with HOA managers on payment plans and account resolutions.

Ensure accurate posting of payments and updates within Vantaca.



Compliance & Documentation

Ensure compliance with HOA governing documents and financial policies.

Maintain organized and audit-ready digital records.

, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide





Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)





 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds





Make the problem feel real and urgent





Show the product clearly and persuasively

Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok





Communicate benefits quickly and clearly





Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof





Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow





Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused





Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast





Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good





We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation





ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover





Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

you also have experience with:

Long-form VSLs or sales videos





Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing





Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools





Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations

Competitive compensation based on experience





Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives





The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue





Clear creative direction and fast feedback





Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time

title: CREATIVE STRATEGIST (DIRECT RESPONSE)
description:
DTC brand, five European markets, $5,000 to $7,000 per day on Meta and soon to be a 7-fig brand.



We got here on a handful of ads. Two creatives carry most of our spend. That is our ceiling, and I am hiring one person to break it.



There is no creative department. No brief template, no tracker, no naming system, no library. On day one you and I build it from nothing, and whoever builds it owns it.



If you want a job where the brief lands in your inbox every Monday, close this tab. If you need someone to tell you what to work on, close this tab. I want one person who takes responsibility on day one without being asked, and who wants to grow into running this side of the business with me.



WHAT YOU OWN

Angles and concepts . Research the customer and turn what she actually says into angles worth testing.

Scripts. This is a copywriting job before it is anything else.

Voiceovers in five languages using AI. You do not speak them. You need a process that catches errors.

The creative tracker. What we test, where, why, and what happened.

Ten new ads a week. Ten with real thinking behind them. We do not spray 50 ads and hope it will work out.

Feedback loops. Understand why we scale and kill ads and improve 1% per day.



You get full visibility into Ads Manager from day one so you can see what your work actually does. You will not run the account. That might change as you earn it.



MUST HAVE

Copywriting, with a portfolio. Not a claim.

Research. You can find out what a customer thinks when she is nothing like you and does not speak your language.

Creative strategy. You have either studied it seriously or run it, and you can point at what you made and what it did.

AI in your daily work. Image, video, voice. Name the tools and what you do in each.

Clear written English.



NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED

You edit your own video and work in paid software like Premiere Pro or After Effects. It tells me you are not a beginner. It will not d
 this on its own.



TERMS

$1,000 to $2,000 per month depending on what you show us.

Full time if you are early in your career and want to grow into this. Part time if you are sharp enough to deliver more in four hours than most people deliver in a day.

Start now.

This is not a three month gap filler that ends in a firing. I am hiring the person who runs creative next to the founder while this scales, and who is still here when the company is many times the size it is today.



DO NOT APPLY IF

You have never written an ad that ran with real money behind it.

You need a brief, a checklist, or a manager.

You think good advertising means beautiful video.

You send the same application to fifty job posts.

You cannot show me one thing you wrote.

You go quiet for two days when something gets hard.



HOW TO APPLY

Send three things. Anything missing and I do not read it.



Start your message with the word MECHANISM.

A link to your portfolio.

How many hours per week you can commit.



Then answer this: link one ad from any brand that you think is great, and in three to five sentences tell me why it works.



Everyone who gets past this step receives a short questionnaire before we talk.

title: Customer Support Specialist for US-based tech company (Full Time)
description:
***IMPORTANT: Hi! My name is Atisha Patel, VP of Customer Success & Operations at Boom. To apply for this job, please fill out the application form: 



You'd be working most closely with Joven Verano, our Customer Support Operations Team Manager, who is based in the Philippines.



COMPANY AND OPPORTUNITY 

Boom is building the agentic operational layer for the residential real estate industry. Property managers and landlords handle significant manual, but critical work that requires intelligence and accuracy: screening applicants, chasing income documents, reviewing reports, answering prospect calls, and often get the same questions a hundred times a week. We're replacing that with software and AI agents that do the work, and a human team that makes sure it's done right.

Our products include BoomScreen (tenant screening: identity verification, income verification, credit, criminal, eviction and rental history reports) and BoomCRM (leads, listings, and AI leasing agents), alongside BoomReport, our rent reporting product. We are a growing team led by top tier investors, a second-time founder CEO, and people with experience across real estate, consulting, and AI. We ship new features every day.



We're seeking a Customer Support Specialist to join our support and operations team. This is a real customer support role -you'll be the person who figures out why an applicant's ID verification is stuck and get them to the finish line, walk a property manager through a screening template, and write up a bug ticket in Jira to help our engineers fix the issue when something is actually broken. You'll primarily be using our customer support platform, Fin (Formerly Intercom), Slack, Teams, and Google Chat, where you will support applicants, leads, and property managers with first-hand questions. In this role, you’ll have an opportunity to use AI tools and agents to improve how you support our customers, quickly and accurately, with empathy. Additionally, our chat is AI-first and escalates to humans, and part of your job is being the human who catches what the AI gets wrong. We're excited to have a work relationship where you learn from us as much as we learn from you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO 

This role is roughly half consumer support and half business customer support, plus ad-hoc project work.

Supporting consumers (Leads, applicants, renters)

Help applicants get through the application itself - identity verification retries and failed uploads, income document submissions (bank statements, paystubs, W-2s), bank and payroll linking, application status questions

Explain next steps and respond to questions clearly and calmly, including sensitive topics like credit, criminal, and eviction records

Handle rent reporting questions (enrollment, verification timelines, credit bureau reporting)

Proactive outreach to applicants who are stuck mid-application, by chat,
, SMS, or phone

Repushing applications when needed, making data corrections (e.g. Name changes)

Supporting business customers (property managers and partners)

Help property managers set up the Boom platform: screening templates and criteria, roles and permissions, application management, running reports, etc.

Troubleshoot technical issues related to tenant screening - For example, when data is not syncing from Boom to a Property Manager’s database

Enter “Guest cards” as needed in the property management system when needed, transferring information from applications

Investigate issues in our admin tools and partner portal before escalating, and give partners a clear answer on what happened and what's next

Work in shared partner channels (Slack, Google Chat, Microsoft Teams) alongside our Customer Success Managers

Diagnosing and escalating bugs

Diagnose the problem immediately, resolve it yourself where you can, explain it in plain language to the customer, and create a well-documented ticket when it needs engineering. Think about how this can be improved moving forward.

A good ticket from you includes the issue, the customer, the relevant admin and portal links, the partner ID, and screenshots or recordings. We'll train you on our process and how to write tickets, and then expect to have you continue that quality

Know the difference between "this needs a bug ticket" and "this is a one-off request" — and know when not to file at all

Ad-hoc projects

Data gathering and research (vendor and competitor research, conference preparation, searching on various websites to understand which softwares are used, and light data analysis)

Data entry and bulk configuration work in our admin tools and partner portal

File creation and spreadsheet work (trackers, enrollment files, audit lists)

Reviewing applications and leads, app store and social review responses, and other one-off projects as they come up



REQUIREMENTS

Must have worked in a customer support role before. This is not an entry-level position

Near-native English, written and verbal. Our support includes chat,
, and voice, and you will be on the phone with US customers

Excellent communication skills. You can explain a technical problem in simple terms and explain exactly which steps you took, and well as expected verses current behavior.

Ability to diagnose, resolve, explain, and ticket technical problems. You investigate before you escalate, and you write up what you found

Ultra high responsiveness across many different communication channels. Our target is under 2 minutes on live chat, and you'll be moving between Intercom, Slack,
, phone, and partner channels all shift. If you go quiet, this role won't work

Comfortable using a support platform. We use Intercom (very similar to Zendesk) inbox, macros, tagging, help center articles

Comfortable working with AI tools. We use Claude in our support team, and you'll be reviewing and correcting AI-suggested responses, not just sending them

Attention to detail. Much of this work involves sensitive consumer data and regulated reports where accuracy matters

Open to change - processes and product change weekly at a startup, and you have to be comfortable with that

Unafraid to ask for help. We're happy to train you and help with problems, but going silent is unacceptable

Ability to work independently, organized, and good at time management

Fast, stable, reliable internet connection, and a quiet place to take calls

Computer specs of at least an Intel i5 processor (or equivalent AMD) and 8GB RAM

Experience with Fin, Google, Teams, and Slack is a plus



OUR TECH STACK INCLUDES

Fin (Intercom) — customer chat,
, SMS, help center, and our AI chat agent (

Slack / Zoom — internal communication

Google Workspace — Sheets, Docs, Gmail, Google Chat

Microsoft Teams Chat

Jira / Confluence — tickets and documentation

Claude — AI assistance & knowledge

Boom Admin and Partner Portal — our internal tools



TRAINING & TEAMING

We have a team of about 30 support team members in the Philippines, with Philippines-based team leads. You will not be figuring this out alone

Your first week in onboarding: tools setup, a full product overview across BoomScreen, BoomCRM, and BoomReport, our daily ops rhythm, and introductions from our leadership team. You'll also shadow experienced teammates on live queues before you own work yourself.

Ongoing training runs on recorded walkthroughs, written SOPs, and direct coaching from your team lead. Joven and our team leads run daily stand-ups and are available on Slack throughout your shift



WORKLOAD & DAYS/TIMES OF WORK

We'll start on a 1-month fully paid trial (we both see how we work together)

~45 hours per week to start

We staff support 7 days a week across multiple shifts, including overnight. Primary coverage is Monday - Friday, 10am - 7pm New York time, and we are also very interested in candidates who can cover overnight shifts and/or at least 1 day of weekend coverage. Tell us in your application what shifts you can commit to

Select US holidays are off; Christmas and New Year's Day are paid non-working days



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$4-5 per hour, with the opportunity to increase as you take on more responsibility

13th month bonus, prorated to the months and hours you've worked at Boom (e.g. if you've been at Boom less than a full year and/or are working less than 40 hours)

Payroll frequency: Every 2 weeks



HOW TO APPLY

Complete the application at this link: 

Applications through OnlineJobs will not be considered



If selected to move forward, you can expect a few short skill tests (a typing test, a quick written communication exercise, and a short research task) before an interview. They're designed to be quick and show us how you actually work, so will be recorded.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EDT/EST (GMT-5), including a 1-hour unpaid lunch break. This role may require availability for a rotating half-day Saturday shift (8:30 AM–12:30 PM EST), approximately once monthly or more as needed.

Note: While three U.S. holidays are fully observed (Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Years), there may be a need for coverage on other U.S. holidays such as Memorial Day, Independence Day (July 4th), and Labor Day due to high lead volume. This is rotational.

Please include the word andromeda in your subject line if reading this

At Native Pest Management, we focus on creating long-term careers for our employees with clear paths for growth. Our goal is to become the largest privately held pest control company in Florida, which will continue to open doors for advancement.

We are committed to providing valuable, comprehensive, and affordable benefits to our employees. Each year, we review our programs to ensure they continue to meet these goals and support our team’s evolving needs. We’re committed to your success now and in the future.



This role requires exceptional English language proficiency, with precise pronunciation and highly effective conversational skills, to ensure clear, confident, and professional communication with team members.



What to Expect During the Hiring Process:

Once you submit your application, our HR team may reach out for an initial phone or Zoom interview. Candidates who move forward may then be invited to an additional follow-up interview, via Zoom or GoogleMeet. Applicants must submit a 2–3 minute video recording (or video link) speaking in English. Light notes or bullet points are fine, but avoid reading word-for-word. Applications submitted without a video link will not be considered. Native Pest Management is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, or any other status protected by federal or Florida law.
