title: Organic Growth Marketer & Video Editor
description:
Type: Full-time or part-time (based on your availability) | 100% remote | US EST hours



About us



Appeals Dr is a fast-growing, Florida-based company that helps Amazon sellers resolve account issues, protect their stores, and scale. We are an Amazon SPN partner with a 93% appeal success rate and $17.8M recovered for sellers. We invest heavily in training, professional growth, and a positive remote culture.



The role



Build and run our organic content engine. You are our internal "Company Detective": you dig through recorded sales calls, Slack, and Salesforce to find real customer wins, turn them into daily short-form content, prep a weekly topic brief for our CEO, and direct his one-hour filming block. You own the process from finding the story to posting the edited video.



You will not start from a blank page. You work from AI-assisted briefs and our content system, so your edge here is execution, judgment, and consistency, not inventing everything alone.



What you'll do



* Publish daily across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn,
, and YouTube Shorts, plus one long-form YouTube video each week. On time, every day.

* Mine for gold: dig through calls, Slack, and the CRM for real wins and quotes, and spot the story others miss.

* Direct the CEO: turn ideas into simple scripts and confidently run his weekly one-hour filming block.

* Edit and write: cut short-form video and write sharp hooks, captions, and posts.

* Build the systems: content calendars and workflows that keep publishing consistent without bottlenecks.

* Keep the proof vault: a tagged Google Drive of clips, case studies, and testimonials so sales can grab a win instantly.

* Engage and escalate: reply to comments and DMs, share content in relevant groups, and flag hot leads to sales the same day.

* Protect the brand: anonymize all client details (store names, IDs, faces) before anything is posted, and never promise guaranteed outcomes. Use only approved stats.

* Track and adjust: monitor views, retention, and engagement, and change your approach based on the numbers.

* Learn the industry: get fluent in Amazon Seller Central and seller pain points. We will train you.



You're a fit if you..



* Are relentlessly consistent. This is the number one requirement. The engine depends on daily posting never slipping.

* Have an editorial eye: you can watch a long video and instantly know the clip.

* Are AI-forward: you use AI tools every day to work faster and write better.

* Can edit and design: hands-on with CapCut or Premiere Pro, and Canva.

* Write sharp copy: hooks, posts, and scripts that get people to act.

* Write and speak fluent, natural English.

* Are comfortable in Slack, Google Drive, and a CRM (Salesforce a plus).

* * Bonus: you have grown an organic audience before.



Mindset



Extreme ownership (you figure things out without hand-holding). Unintimidated (comfortable directing the CEO on camera and keeping him on schedule). Curious about the technical side of Amazon. Genuinely data-driven.



What success looks like (first 90 days)



* 100% on-time daily posting across all channels.

* The CEO gets a full topic brief before every filming session, so he never has to brainstorm.

* An organized, tagged proof vault the sales team actually uses.

* Month-over-month growth in engagement, video retention, and inbound leads.



Compensation and growth



* Monthly salary or hourly rate based on your experience and hours.

* Performance bonuses tied directly to the results you generate.

* A paid budget for approved courses and books, plus direct mentorship.

* A fast-paced, results-driven team that rewards initiative.



How to apply (please follow all steps)



1. Show us what you can do. Send a 1-minute Loom or Google Drive video on why you are a fit for this role, along with your resume, video portfolio, and copywriting samples.

2. Paid challenge. If your application stands out, we send you a short paid task that mirrors the real work.

3. Interview. Nail the challenge and we invite you to meet the team and align on your first 90 days.



Applications without the 1-minute video and samples will not be reviewed.

title: DME Rental & Reimbursement Specialist
description:
We are looking for a dependable and detail-oriented DME Rental & Reimbursement Specialist to join our Billing & Reimbursement Team. This position is responsible for monitoring active DME rental accounts and ensuring rentals are followed through from monthly billing to completion, continuation, or equipment return.



The specialist will work closely with Billing, Prior Authorization, and other departments to address expiring documentation, authorization requirements, Stop/Hold accounts, reimbursement issues, and other items that could delay or prevent payment.



Essential Responsibilities

• Review active DME rental accounts on the first business day of each month and maintain a 30/60/90-day tracking process for upcoming rental, CMN/order, and PAR expirations.

• Monitor rental months, allowable rental periods, authorization periods, and end dates to determine whether rental billing should continue or stop.

• Review the Stop/Hold Report, research the reason for the hold, and take the appropriate action to resolve the account.

• Create and follow up on tasks for CMN/order renewals, PAR continuation, and other documentation needed for continued rental.

• Review No Pricing Found and capped-rental conversion issues and make or coordinate the appropriate Brightree Price Table or Sales Order corrections.

• Review expired or completed rentals with open invoices and determine whether the account requires payer follow-up, claim correction, reconciliation, or an approved adjustment.

• Communicate with patients or authorized representatives regarding rental status and explain equipment-return requirements when applicable.

• Coordinate the return or pickup of company-owned rental equipment when the rental is discontinued or the patient is deceased and follow up until the equipment is accounted for.

• Review terminated rental accounts for possible patient credits or overpayments and coordinate refund review when applicable.

• Maintain clear and accurate Brightree account notes, tasks, stop dates, adjustments, equipment-return information, and follow-up documentation.

• Assist with rental account reviews and audits and bring recurring billing, documentation, reimbursement, or equipment concerns to Billing & Reimbursement leadership.

Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• 1–3 years of DME/HME billing, reimbursement, authorization, or healthcare revenue-cycle experience preferred.

• Experience with recurring and capped rental DME preferred.



Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance preferred.

• Working knowledge of CMNs, SWOs, prior authorizations, HCPCS codes, modifiers, rental periods, and DME billing requirements.

• Brightree or similar DME billing-system and electronic health information systems experience preferred.

• Comfortable researching payer portals, authorization information, claims, and account history.

• Demonstrated analytical, organizational, research, documentation, problem-solving, account reconciliation, and follow-up skills.

• Ability to independently manage a high-volume work queue and prioritize accounts based on deadlines.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, payer portals, Brightree, Availity, Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements.



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is proactive, organized, dependable, and willing to take ownership of their accounts. The right candidate will not simply identify an issue and move on; they will research the account, determine what is needed, communicate with the appropriate department, and follow the issue through to resolution.

This position is a good fit for someone who understands how rental billing, documentation, authorizations, reimbursement, and equipment management work together within the DME revenue cycle.



Department: Billing & Reimbursement

Position: DME Rental & Reimbursement Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Billing Manager

title: Video Editor Needed for Firearms Training & Tactical Social Media Content
description:
We are a professional firearms and tactical training company looking for an experienced video editor/content creator to turn our existing raw video footage into high-quality, engaging social media content.



We regularly capture raw footage from firearms training courses, range days, tactical training, instructor demonstrations, scenario-based training, and other company activities. We need someone who can take that raw content and turn it into professional, fast-paced videos that showcase our training, instructors, capabilities, and brand.



### What We Need



You will be given access to our library of raw video footage and will be responsible for reviewing the footage, identifying the best clips, and creating finished videos for platforms such as:



* Instagram / Reels

*

* YouTube / YouTube Shorts

* LinkedIn

* TikTok, where appropriate

* Other social media and marketing platforms



We do **not** want to have to select every clip or tell you exactly how to edit every video. We are looking for someone with a creative eye who can review our footage, identify what will make good content, and build the video from beginning to end.



Editing Style



Our videos should have a professional, tactical, modern, and high-energy feel without looking cheesy or overproduced.



We are looking for editing that may include:



* Fast, clean cuts and transitions

* Quick transitions between shooting and training sequences

* Slow motion when it adds impact

* B-roll and multiple camera angles

* Professional titles and text overlays

* Banners and callouts

* Course or service names

* Instructor names/titles when appropriate

* Company logo placement and branded outros

* Music and sound design

* Clean audio and audio enhancement

* Captions/subtitles when appropriate

* Calls to action

* Website or contact information

* Consistent branding across all videos



The final product should make someone watching think, "This is a professional firearms training organization, and I want to train with them."



Content Goals



The videos should help us showcase and market services such as:



* Firearms training

* Pistol courses

* Rifle/carbine courses

* Concealed carry/CCW training

* Scenario-based training

* Force-on-force training

* Shoot/no-shoot training

* Private firearms instruction

* Tactical training

* Range training

* Instructor expertise

* Upcoming classes and events



Some videos will be short-form social media content designed to grab attention quickly, while others may be longer promotional or educational videos.



What We're Looking For



The ideal editor:



* Has experience creating Reels, Shorts, TikToks, and social media marketing videos

* Understands pacing and how to capture attention within the first few seconds

* Can work independently with a large amount of raw footage

* Has a strong understanding of branding and marketing

* Can create professional graphics, titles, banners, and transitions

* Understands how to format content for different social platforms

* Can take direction while also bringing creative ideas to the table

* Is comfortable working with firearms and tactical training footage

* Can maintain an organized content library and editing workflow



Experience editing firearms, military, law enforcement, outdoor, tactical, fitness, automotive, or action-sports content is a major plus!



Ongoing Opportunity



We are looking for someone we can work with long term, not just for a single video.



We want to develop a consistent stream of professionally edited content using the footage we are already capturing. If the relationship works well, there will be ongoing opportunities to edit new footage, create promotional videos for upcoming courses, and help develop our overall video presence across social media.



To Apply



Please send:



1. Examples of your best short-form social media videos.

2. Examples of action-oriented, tactical, firearms, military, fitness, automotive, or similar fast-paced content if available.

3. A brief explanation of how you would approach turning a folder of raw footage into multiple pieces of social media content.

4. Your typical turnaround time.

5. Your pricing structure, whether hourly, per video, or monthly.

6. What editing software you primarily use.

Please do not send a generic application. We are specifically looking for someone who understands how to take raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging content that helps market a professional training company.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant: Research, Follow-Up and Operations Support
description:
Mindcore Technologies is a Boca Raton based technology firm delivering managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, compliance, and AI transformation services to growing companies.



We are hiring one part-time Executive Virtual Assistant to support our Marketing Director and our CEO directly.

 and submit resume here and to: 



This is not a passive admin role. There is no inbox to babysit and no calendar to color code. You will be given hard questions and told to come back with answers. You will chase people who owe work and come back with the real status, not the polite version of it. If you are the kind of person who cannot let an unanswered question sit, keep reading.



What You Will Do:



Research and Answers

-Take open questions and return decision-ready answers, usually same day. Example: "Our TikTok account is locked and our X account is banned. Find out why, find every recovery path, and tell me what actually works for accounts like ours."

-Run deep research on B2B content performance: what formats, hooks, and posting patterns are currently driving reach and leads for technology and professional services companies on LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and X.

-Research competitors, platform policy changes, tools, vendors, and market trends on request.

-Build and maintain standing research monitors using AI tools, so trend changes arrive automatically instead of waiting to be searched for. Deliver a short weekly digest of what changed and what we should do about it.

-Turn every research output into a one page brief: what you found, what it means, what you recommend, what you need from us.



Follow-Up and Accountability

-Check in with team members and sub-departments on assigned priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

-Maintain a single weekly status tracker: complete, in progress, blocked, overdue, next.

-Push for real answers. "I'm working on it" is not a status. Your job is to establish what is actually done, what is actually blocking it, and what the actual next date is.

-Flag stalled work, missed handoffs, and silent failures early, before they surface in a leadership meeting.

-Track social media output and results across LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X, and
: what was published, where it went, and what it produced. You are not creating or posting the content. You are making sure it shipped and reporting what it earned.



Executive Support

-Support the CEO with research, briefing documents, meeting prep, summaries, and light scheduling coordination.

-Prepare short pre-meeting research packets on companies and individuals ahead of calls.

-Document repeatable processes so the same work does not get rebuilt every month.

-What Success Looks Like in the First 30 Days

-Leadership can see, in one place, what is moving, what is stuck, and who owns it.

-Research requests come back the same day, in writing, with a recommendation attached.

-At least two standing monitors are live and producing a useful weekly digest.

-Assigned tasks stop disappearing after they are assigned.

-The Marketing Director and CEO spend measurably less time chasing updates.



What We Need From You

-Extreme proactivity. You do not need reminders, and you do not wait to be asked twice.

-Strong research instincts, including advanced use of AI tools to compress hours of work into minutes.

-Excellent written English. Short, clear, direct. No filler.

-Comfort following up persistently and professionally with people who are senior to you.

-Strong organization and genuine follow-through across many parallel threads.

-Sound judgment on confidentiality and professional communication.

-Working familiarity with spreadsheets, task trackers, Google Workspace, and major social platforms.

-Reliable internet, a quiet work environment, and overlap with US Eastern Time business hours.



Helpful, Not Required

-Prior support of a founder, CEO, or marketing leader.

-Background in B2B, managed IT, cybersecurity, SaaS, AI, or professional services.

-Experience with HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, SEMrush, Google Analytics, or social scheduling platforms.

-Experience building AI research workflows, agents, or automated monitors.

-This Is Not For You If

-You prefer clearly defined tasks handed to you one at a time.

-You are uncomfortable pressing a colleague for a straight answer.

-You want to specialize in one narrow function.

-You are looking for a quiet part-time role alongside three other clients.



Compensation and Growth

-$500 USD per month, paid monthly.

-20 hours per week, scheduled with meaningful overlap with US Eastern Time.

-Fully remote, long term.

-Hours, scope, and pay increase based on demonstrated output. Strong performers here move into larger roles on our marketing and AI teams.

title: CPA working with CFO
description:
CPA/Accounting financial advisor  Virtual Assistant (Construction)



Mazzamuto Construction Inc. | Remote | Part-Time, with potential to move to Full-Time | $8–$14+/hour (based on experience)

Mazzamuto Construction Inc. is a family-owned residential construction and remodeling company based in Martinez, California. We are hiring an Accounting Virtual Assistant to maintain accurate books, job costs, and work-in-progress (WIP) reporting, and to work directly with the company’s CFO.

This role starts part-time and may expand to full-time for the right person. A CPA license is required. QuickBooks experience is required. You must work Pacific Time hours from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM PT.

This is a long-term position for someone who is precise with numbers, comfortable with construction accounting, and confident enough to enforce spending discipline. A strong personality is required. This is not a passive data-entry role.

Position Overview

You will report to and work directly with the CFO. In addition to bookkeeping and job costing, you will support cash-flow forecasting, prepare WIP reports, help establish spending policies, and follow through so those policies are applied consistently. You will also coordinate with project and design staff and prepare files for month-end close with our U.S.-based CPA.

Schedule



Must work 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday through Friday

Part-time to start, with the opportunity to move to full-time based on performance and business need



Responsibilities

Partnership with the CFO



Work directly with the CFO on weekly and monthly financial priorities

Support cash-flow forecasting, including expected receipts, vendor payments, job draws, and near-term cash needs

Help draft and maintain spending policies (approvals, purchase limits, coding rules, and documentation standards)

Track compliance with those policies and flag exceptions

Hold team members accountable for timely submissions, proper coding, budget overruns, and missing paperwork by following up, documenting issues, and escalating unresolved items to the CFO

Push back professionally when costs are uncoded, over budget, or missing support

Prepare the CFO with clean, current numbers before owner or CPA reviews



Accounting operations



Record expenses, invoices, receipts, bills, and payments

Maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable

Reconcile bank, credit card, and other accounts on a set schedule

Keep QuickBooks Online current and organized

Update Buildertrend (or equivalent construction software) with financial and job-cost data

Maintain supporting spreadsheets for cash flow, AP/AR, and project costs

Organize source documents for CPA review



Job costing



Code labor, materials, subcontractors, and other costs to the correct job

Compare estimated vs. actual costs

Track cost-to-complete and flag overruns or coding errors

Support estimating with historical cost data



WIP reporting (required)



Prepare and maintain work-in-progress (WIP) reports on a weekly and month-end basis

Track percent complete, estimated cost at completion, job profit/loss, and over/under billing

Reconcile WIP to QuickBooks and job-cost records

Explain material variances and raise issues to the CFO before month-end close



Reporting



Build a simple weekly dashboard for the CFO and owner

Prepare P&L snapshots by company and by job

Maintain rolling cash-flow forecasts

Produce job profitability summaries



Collaboration



Support month-end close with the U.S. CPA

Coordinate with other VAs, the designer, and project teams

Keep financial records current so leadership can make decisions from live data



Requirements



CPA license required

QuickBooks experience required (QuickBooks Online strongly preferred)

Bookkeeping or accounting experience; construction or project-based accounting strongly preferred

Buildertrend or similar construction management software preferred

Must prepare accurate WIP reports (percent complete, cost-to-complete, over/under billing)

Experience with cash-flow forecasting preferred

Must have a strong personality: assertive, direct, and willing to hold people accountable

Comfortable implementing spending rules and following up when those rules are not followed

Able to challenge incomplete or inaccurate information without being combative

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets

Strong written English

Highly organized, consistent, and careful with confidential financial information

Must be available 10:00 AM–4:00 PM Pacific Time

Stable internet and a dedicated workspace

Available to start part-time and increase hours if the role grows



Ideal candidate



Licensed CPA with hands-on QuickBooks experience

Reliable and systems-oriented

Comfortable owning financial data, not only entering it

Willing to question numbers that do not tie out

Direct, firm, and professional when following up on budgets, receipts, and policy exceptions

Not easily dismissed or talked out of proper process

Interested in growing from part-time to full-time with the company



Compensation



Remote

Part-time to start, with the opportunity to move to full-time based on performance and business need

$8–$14 + per hour, depending on experience

Long-term position



To apply, send a resume, CPA license details (jurisdiction and status), and a brief note describing your QuickBooks experience, any construction job-costing or WIP work you have done, cash-flow forecasting experience, and confirmation that you can work 10:00 AM–4:00 PM Pacific Time. Include one example of a time you enforced a process or spending rule when others pushed back.

Phase 2: Skills Sample Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short sample edit to demonstrate hands-on skill.

title: Creative Short-Form Video Editor — TikTok / Reels — Part-Time
description:
We're hiring a video editor to turn our footage into TikToks and Instagram Reels for Moodsearch, a reflection app where people share what's on their mind and explore possible emotional and behavioral patterns over time.



Our team provides footage, brand assets and product recordings, and handles content strategy, filming, publishing and final approval. You'll edit interviews, everyday moments, brand stories and product demonstrations.



THE WORK



- Find the strongest moments, choose an opening and shape a story worth finishing.

- Edit vertical videos with clean audio, accurate captions and appropriate music or motion. Effects should add something to the video.

- Suggest stronger openings or useful edits, and flag missing footage early. Brief ideas that improve the footage or next shoot are welcome.

- Apply feedback to later edits and keep exports and editable project files organized.

- Preserve the speaker's meaning and use accurate product footage.



You should be comfortable making editing decisions from a brief without step-by-step instructions. Show us work that demonstrates your judgment; a smaller portfolio is welcome. Clear written English matters for captions and feedback. Use your preferred software, subject to compatible project-file handoff.



HOURS, OUTPUT AND PAY



This is an ongoing remote, part-time role for a Philippines-based editor. Our initial plan is approximately 25 paid hours per week.



We need around 15 distinct, publish-ready videos per week once the workflow is established. The starting mix is eight lighter cuts, five developed stories or demos, and two distinct videos testing a different editing or storytelling approach. Those experiments are included in the 15. Corrections, resizes and minor hook or music swaps do not count as additional videos.



Most videos will be 30–60 seconds long. We will scope any longer or unusually complex edits separately.



Before agreeing a firm estimate, shortlisted candidates will receive representative raw footage and style references. We'll agree source-footage limits, finished lengths, deadlines, revision rounds and music/stock responsibilities. If the mix needs more than 25 hours, explain your estimate so we can agree workable paid capacity before proceeding.



Our opening range is $5–$7 USD/hour, depending on your work. If your rate differs, include it with your relevant examples for consideration.



Agreed footage review, editing, brief suggestions, organization and revisions are paid. Additional hours or changes beyond the agreed scope need approval before work begins.



A completed video meets the agreed brief and technical requirements, preserves meaning, has accurate captions and product details, and is ready to publish. All agreed hours worked are paid, including scoped revisions, even if we are still reviewing a video or choose not to publish it. We track delays awaiting our footage or feedback separately from your working time.



PAID PILOT AND APPLICATION



Selected finalists may be invited to a two-week paid pilot with agreed hours, fees and starting deliverables. It begins with one Reel, an alternate opening, brief timestamped selection notes and a missing-footage suggestion where useful. After consolidated feedback, you'll edit fresh footage so we can assess how the feedback carries over. The pilot will establish the hours and workflow needed for ongoing output.



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



1. Three relevant videos and your exact contribution. For one, explain your opening and a storytelling decision you made.

2. Your preliminary weekly hours estimate for the proposed mix, including footage review and revisions, and what you need to confirm it.

3. Your hourly rate, availability, time zone, earliest start date, editing software and ability to provide editable project files.

Oversee

title: Demand & Supply Planner – End-to-End Planning & MRP
description:
Who We Are



Starbond is a growing adhesive company committed to excellence, customer centricity, curiosity, humility, and continuous improvement. We sell through Amazon, Shopify, and B2B channels and are strengthening our supply chain planning capabilities to support reliable product availability and scalable growth.



The Role



Starbond is seeking a highly analytical and proactive Demand & Supply Planner with at least five years of hands-on experience across the complete planning cycle: demand forecasting, supply planning, inventory optimization, material requirements planning (MRP), and production planning.



This role owns planning from end to end. You will develop a reliable consensus demand forecast, convert it into inventory and material requirements, and create executable purchasing, production, and distribution plans. You will monitor actual performance, identify changes and risks, and continuously revise the plan based on new information.



This is not a role for someone who has only maintained an existing planning system. The successful candidate must also be able to build, audit, and improve an Excel-based planning and MRP tool from the ground up. You will connect channel forecasts, bills of materials, inventory, open purchase orders, supplier lead times, capacity, and production requirements into one dependable planning process.



The ideal candidate combines strong technical planning knowledge with excellent judgment, emotional intelligence, ownership, and proactive communication. You should be comfortable identifying weak assumptions, explaining risks clearly, and recommending practical improvements rather than waiting for detailed instructions.



Key Responsibilities



Demand Planning and Forecast Ownership

Own the SKU- and channel-level demand forecast across Amazon, Shopify, and B2B.

Develop rolling forecasts using sales history, seasonality, promotions, customer commitments, product life cycles, channel plans, market intelligence, and future business assumptions.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and leadership to gather forecast inputs, challenge assumptions, resolve differences, and establish a documented consensus demand plan.

Separate baseline demand from promotional, event-driven, new-product, and one-time demand.

Track forecast accuracy and bias by SKU and channel, investigate material variances, and improve forecasting methods over time.

Maintain documented forecast assumptions, risks, opportunities, scenarios, and version history.

Identify demand changes early and clearly communicate their expected impact on inventory, purchasing, production, capacity, and cash flow.



Supply and Inventory Planning

Translate the approved demand forecast into time-phased inventory, purchasing, production, and distribution requirements.

Establish and maintain SKU-level reorder points, safety stock, order quantities, and inventory targets.

Apply appropriate safety-stock methods using desired service levels, demand variability, lead-time variability, and supplier reliability.

Monitor stockout risks, excess inventory, slow-moving products, inventory turnover, forecast accuracy, and service levels.

Create constrained and unconstrained supply plans and identify where supplier, material, capacity, cash, or storage limitations prevent the business from meeting demand.

Recommend prioritized actions that balance customer service, inventory investment, operating cost, and business risk.



MRP and Excel Tool Development

Build, maintain, audit, and improve an Excel-based MRP and replenishment system.

Integrate core planning data, including the SKU master, sales forecast, stock on hand, open purchase orders, supplier lead times, bills of materials, and purchasing recommendations.

Create reliable formulas, data-validation controls, exception flags, dashboards, and scenario models that make the tool accurate, understandable, and easy to maintain.

Identify broken links, duplicated data, manual work, weak assumptions, and opportunities for automation.

Document planning logic, data sources, ownership, update frequency, and standard operating procedures.



BOM, Materials, and Production Planning

Perform BOM explosion by converting finished-goods demand into component, packaging, and raw-material requirements.

Account for existing component inventory, open orders, lead times, minimum order quantities, yields, scrap, and production constraints.

Translate material availability and demand requirements into practical production schedules.

Identify material shortages, capacity conflicts, and timing risks early and recommend feasible solutions.

Coordinate with Procurement, Operations, suppliers, and warehouse partners to align purchase and production plans.



Supply Planning and Risk Management

Evaluate supplier performance, including actual versus quoted lead times, delivery reliability, quality issues, and supply variability.

Recommend safety-stock adjustments, order timing, secondary sourcing, or other mitigation measures based on quantified risk.

Develop supply scenarios for demand changes, supplier delays, promotions, new-product launches, and capacity limitations.

Ensure planning recommendations balance product availability, working capital, storage constraints, and operational cost.



S&OP, Reporting, and Cross-Functional Communication

Provide concise planning updates that clearly identify risks, business impact, recommended actions, responsible owners, and deadlines.

Lead or support a structured monthly S&OP planning cycle connecting demand, supply, inventory, capacity, and financial considerations.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Operations, and leadership to reconcile forecasts with supply capabilities and business priorities.

Present S&OP scenarios, gaps, tradeoffs, assumptions, and recommendations to decision-makers.

Document agreed decisions and ensure changes flow into the demand forecast, supply plan, purchasing plan, and production schedule.

Communicate proactively when information is incomplete, assumptions change, or a plan is at risk.



Required Qualifications



At least five years of hands-on experience covering both demand planning and supply planning, including inventory, materials, or production planning.

Demonstrated ownership of a rolling SKU-level forecast and the ability to translate it into an executable supply plan.

Strong understanding of forecasting methods, seasonality, promotions, forecast accuracy, forecast bias, consensus planning, and scenario analysis.

Demonstrated experience building or substantially redesigning an MRP, inventory-planning, or replenishment tool in Excel.

Strong knowledge of reorder-point logic, safety-stock modeling, lead-time variability, service levels, and inventory optimization.

Practical experience with BOM explosion and raw-material or component planning.

Advanced Excel skills, including structured tables, XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, PivotTables, conditional logic, data validation, error controls, and scenario modeling.

Experience translating forecasts into purchase and production requirements.

Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong ownership, emotional intelligence, attention to detail, and proactive communication.

Availability to work a full-time schedule aligned with Pacific Time.

title: Procurement Specialist (experience with US and Asian suppliers required)
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a U.S.-based manufacturer and eCommerce company specializing in high-performance adhesives and industrial products. We serve customers through Amazon, Shopify, and B2B distribution channels across multiple global markets.



We are looking for a Procurement Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building supplier relationships, negotiating favorable commercial terms, solving supply chain challenges, and continuously improving procurement operations. This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, proactive, highly organized, and comfortable working with suppliers across multiple countries and cultures.







Position Summary

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for sourcing and managing suppliers across the United States and Asia, negotiating pricing and commercial terms, evaluating supplier capabilities, and ensuring a reliable and cost-effective supply of materials.



This role plays a critical part in protecting supply continuity, reducing procurement costs, supporting contract manufacturing initiatives, and ensuring Starbond maintains a diversified supplier network that supports long-term business growth.



Key Responsibilities



Strategic Sourcing

Source, evaluate, and qualify suppliers across the United States and Asia.

Conduct supplier research, RFQs, quotation comparisons, and supplier evaluations.

Develop and maintain qualified primary and backup suppliers for critical materials.

Identify new sourcing opportunities that improve cost, quality, and supply continuity.

Support contract manufacturer and third-party logistics (3PL) sourcing initiatives.

Verify supplier capabilities, certifications, and compliance requirements.



Supplier Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers.

Monitor supplier responsiveness, lead times, pricing, and overall performance.

Conduct supplier performance reviews and maintain supplier scorecards.

Coordinate corrective actions when supplier performance issues arise.

Work closely with suppliers to resolve procurement challenges and minimize operational disruptions.



Cost Optimization

Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements.

Analyze supplier quotations and landed costs.

Benchmark supplier pricing and market conditions.

Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and supply reliability.

Recommend sourcing strategies that improve overall profitability.



Procurement Operations

Maintain accurate supplier records and procurement databases.

Support purchase order creation and supplier follow-ups.

Keep supplier pricing, lead times, MOQs, and procurement data up to date.

Organize procurement documentation and sourcing records.

Ensure procurement information is accurate, complete, and audit-ready.



Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Prepare procurement reports and sourcing updates.

Maintain procurement dashboards and tracking tools.

Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes and documentation.

Support continuous improvement initiatives across procurement and supply chain operations.

Proactively identify supply risks and recommend mitigation strategies.





Qualifications



Required

Minimum 3 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or supply chain.

Hands-on experience working with both U.S. and Asian suppliers (China, Taiwan, Vietnam, India, or other APAC countries).

Proven experience sourcing, qualifying, and negotiating with international suppliers.

Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.

Excellent analytical and cost analysis abilities.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.



Preferred

Experience working with contract manufacturers or OEM/ODM suppliers.

Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial products, chemicals, or eCommerce businesses.

Familiarity with ERP, MRP, or procurement management systems.

Experience analyzing supplier performance metrics and procurement KPIs.





What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who:

Takes ownership and follows through without constant supervision.

Builds strong supplier relationships while negotiating effectively.

Thinks strategically and solves problems proactively.

Communicates clearly and escalates risks early.

Makes data-driven decisions rather than assumptions.

Continuously looks for opportunities to improve procurement processes.

Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

Can comfortably work with suppliers across different countries, cultures, and time zones.

title: TikTok shop/short form video editor
description:
I’m looking for a highly experienced, high-quality short-form video editor to become a long-term teammate and help me build something massive in the TikTok Shop space.



This is NOT just an editing job. I’m looking for someone who wants to lock in, grind, learn, experiment, and build with me for the next few years.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING



* Editing 20–30 high-quality TikTok Shop videos/ads per day

* Creating fast-paced, engaging videos specifically designed for TikTok

* Helping strategically structure videos to maximize retention, engagement, and sales

* Understanding hooks, pacing, storytelling, pattern interrupts, CTAs, and sales psychology

* Studying performance data and constantly improving our editing/content strategy

* Working closely with me to develop and test new creative concepts

* Joining calls with me every few days to review videos, results, ideas, and strategy



Every video needs to be very intentionally and strategically thought out.



I don’t want someone who just cuts clips together. I want someone who understands WHY a video will perform and can help me make the content itself better.



You should be:



* Very experienced with short-form content

* Extremely strong at editing TikTok-style videos

* Fast without sacrificing quality

* Creative and willing to experiment

* Highly motivated and willing to lock in

* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting to be told exactly what to do

* Interested in the psychology behind what makes people watch, engage, and buy

* Looking for a long-term opportunity, not a temporary freelance gig



Extra points if you have experience with:



* TikTok Shop

* Direct-response advertising

* Sales psychology

* Consumer psychology

* Influencer marketing

* Viral content strategy

* Content analytics

* Growing social media accounts





As we grow and establish a strong working relationship, there is potential for:



* Equity

* A percentage of sales generated

* Increased compensation

* Performance-based bonuses

* A much bigger role within the business



The goal is for this to eventually become a real partnership, not an employer/employee relationship.



🚀 THE VISION



I’m trying to take this as far as I possibly can.



I want to build one of the biggest TikTok Shop/content operations possible, and I know that doesn’t happen with one person.



I’m looking for someone who has the same mentality:



Lock in. Work every day. Test constantly. Learn constantly. Improve constantly.



I want us to be in the same headspace and genuinely care about building something huge together.



If we work well together, I don’t want you to feel like “the editor.”



I want you to feel like part of the team building the company.



📩 HOW TO APPLY



Send me:



1. Your portfolio / examples of your best work

2. Your experience with TikTok or short-form content

3. Any experience with TikTok Shop, advertising, or sales content

4. Your typical turnaround time

5. Your current availability

6. Why you think you’d be a good long-term fit for this



Most importantly: tell me what you think makes a TikTok Shop video go viral AND convert.



I’m looking for someone who sees this as an opportunity to build something, not just another editing job.

description:
Buzz ABA is a growing provider of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services focused on delivering high-quality care to children and families in New Hampshire. As we continue to expand, hiring exceptional people quickly and consistently is one of the most important things we do.



We are looking for an exceptional, high-output Recruiter who can take ownership of our recruiting funnel and help us consistently identify, engage, interview, and hire great candidates for behavioral technicians and board certified behavioral analysts. We are looking for someone who enjoys recruiting, moves quickly, loves talking to candidates, knows how to create urgency, and takes personal ownership of hiring results.



Prior experience recruiting within ABA, behavioral health, healthcare, or another high-volume environment is a plus, but it is not required. We care most about your ability to consistently produce results.



Your responsibilities will include:

title: SEO Content Associate
description:
THIS IS A SALARIED, EMPLOYEE OF RECORD OPPORTUNITY



SEO Content Associate

Job Description

WHAT TO EXPECT:

Wonderist Agency is a full-service marketing agency that supports 1,000+ dentists around the country. We pride ourselves on ditching the old fashioned marketing model of stock photos and templated sites. We strive to tell our clients' stories with bespoke brands, impactful photo and video shoots, and stunning website design (Here is a great example of our work: 
)

We're a team of over 70+ passionate marketers headquartered in sunny San Diego, with a growing global team. While many companies simply check the required boxes when it comes to culture, a well-balanced team and positive office culture has been the core of our success from the start. We are a social team at heart, and that is one constant that hasn't changed with all the movement this economy and industry has seen. We genuinely enjoy spending time together, and we work hard to make sure that's true whether you're in the office or across the world.

We celebrate new ideas and prioritize a culture of trust and respect where team members can grow and take risks. Each quarter we host events under our four cultural pillars; health & wellness, personal & professional development, social good, and social. We are proud to have been named one of San Diego Business Journal's Best Places to Work in 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023, made the Inc 5000 Regionals Fastest Growing Companies 2021, 2022 and 2024, made the San Diego Business Journal's Fastest Growing Private Companies list in 2019, 2020, 2022, and 2023, made the Inc Best Workplaces list in 2024 and made the Inc. 5000 for the last 5 years (
)!

If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The SEO Content Associate owns content operations across our entire SEO book. Content is the most client-visible thing we produce, and today it's split across people who each have something else as their main job — which means it's the first thing to slip when a week gets busy. This role exists to fix that.

You'll own the content board end to end: ordering content against each client's twelve-month calendar, running SEO quality assurance on everything that comes back, and building internal links so new content actually connects to the rest of the site.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who cares about content quality, is comfortable working at volume, and wants to build expertise in SEO content strategy.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Content Ordering & Board Management

Order content against each client's approved twelve-month content calendar, ensuring briefs include target keywords, search intent, and internal linking direction.

Own the content board in 
, tracking every piece from ordered through drafted, QA'd, and published.

Flag accounts are approaching the end of their content calendar so the assigned Specialist can build the next cycle before the account runs dry.

Content Quality Assurance

Review every piece of content before publication against our SEO standards including keyword usage, header structure, meta title and description, content length, readability, and formatting.

Verify factual and brand accuracy against the client's brand guidelines and service offering.

Check that content is formatted answer-first where the search results show question intent, and that FAQ sections carry FAQ schema.

Return work that doesn't meet standard with specific, actionable feedback.

Internal Linking

Build internal links from new content into relevant service and location pages, and from existing content into new pages.

Maintain a working understanding of each client's site architecture so linking is strategic rather than arbitrary.

Content Refresh Support

Support content refresh work identified during quarterly account reviews — pages losing impressions in Search Console that need updating, extending, or merging.

Additional Responsibilities

Contribute to cross-team projects, process improvements, and new initiatives as assigned.

Take on new responsibilities and special projects as business needs evolve, with opportunities to learn and grow.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

Editorial Judgment: Can tell the difference between content that technically meets the brief and content that is actually good.

Attention to Detail: Catches a keyword stuffed into a header, a meta description over the character limit, or a factual claim that doesn't match the client's services.

Volume Management: Works through a high-volume review queue consistently, without quality slipping at the end of the day.

Written Communication: Gives feedback specific enough to act on and clear enough not to require a follow-up conversation.

SEO Fundamentals: Understands search intent, keyword targeting, and on-page structure well enough to review against them.

Organizational Skills: Tracks hundreds of content pieces at different stages without losing any of them.

Ownership: Treats content quality as their responsibility, not the writer's.

PERSONALITY MUSTS:

Our perfect fit is someone who is a problem solver who understands the difference between “yes, and…” and “yes, but…”. You should have a hungry, scrappy personality with a positive attitude and aims to deliver. Working in the client service industry can mean going the extra mile, and we need someone who is always willing to rise to the occasion for our clients and puts forward beautiful work that exceeds client expectations. Someone who is detailed and organized, driven and displays vigor and comes ready to play every day. Confidence, self-discipline, and a congenial, curious mind are things we love and admire.

The ideal SEO Content Associate has strong opinions about writing and is comfortable voicing them. You notice when a piece is technically fine but reads like it was written by someone who has never been to a dentist. You're organized enough to hold a large content operation in your head, and you care that what we publish is actually worth reading.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

1–3 years of content, editorial, or SEO experience.

Excellent written English — this role is fundamentally about judging the quality of English writing.

Working knowledge of on-page SEO including keyword targeting, search intent, header structure, and meta titles and descriptions.

Experience reviewing or editing content against a defined standard.

Comfortable with a CMS such as Webflow or WordPress.

Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive).

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage high volume without dropping work.

BONUS POINTS FOR APPLICANTS WITH:

Healthcare or dental content experience

Experience with content briefs and working with freelance or agency writers

Familiarity with schema markup, particularly FAQ schema

Google Search Console experience


 or comparable project management tooling

Experience using AI tools in a content workflow

title: Physics Curriculum Assistant – Worksheet & Curriculum Development
description:
I am looking for someone with a strong understanding of Physics, particularly Mechanics, to help me develop educational materials for high school Physics courses.



This position will initially focus on creating Physics worksheets, homework assignments, quizzes, reviews, and test questions. However, I am looking for someone I can work with long-term who may eventually help me develop larger portions of complete Physics curricula.







IMPORTANT: Strong Physics Knowledge Required



You must have a solid understanding of Physics.



During the interview process, I will ask you to solve Physics problems in real-time and explain your reasoning. If you are not confident solving high school and introductory college-level Mechanics problems, please do not apply.



A Physics degree or previous experience teaching Physics would be a major advantage, but it is not required if you can demonstrate strong Physics knowledge.







What You Will Be Doing



I am currently developing Physics courses and need help creating original Physics questions and solutions for high-level high school students.



These questions may be used for:

Homework assignments

Worksheets

Quizzes

Unit reviews

Tests

Future curriculum materials



I will provide examples and templates showing the style and difficulty level I am looking for.



For each assignment, I will provide:

- The Physics topics being covered.

- Examples of the types and difficulty of questions I want.

- Formatting/templates when necessary.



You will provide:

- Original Physics questions that do not create copyright issues.

- Complete and accurate solutions/answer keys.

- Materials formatted according to the provided template.

- Careful review of every question to make sure the wording, numbers, diagrams, units, and answers are correct.

Using AI



Using AI tools such as ChatGPT is encouraged.



However, you cannot simply copy and paste AI-generated questions.



You are responsible for checking that:



The Physics is correct.

- The problem actually makes sense.

- All necessary information is provided.

- The numerical answer is correct.

- Units and significant details are correct.

- The question is appropriate for the intended student level.



Strong ATTENTION TO DETAIL  is extremely important for this position.







The Ideal Candidate



I am looking for someone who:

- Has a strong understanding of Physics, especially Mechanics.

- Has excellent attention to detail.

- Can solve Physics problems accurately.

- Can follow detailed instructions

- Is comfortable using Microsoft Word and PowerPoint.

- Has experience using AI tools effectively.

- Communicates clearly and asks questions when something is unclear.

- Is interested in learning how to create high-quality educational curriculum.



Previous experience as a Physics teacher, tutor, Physics major, engineer, or curriculum developer would be especially helpful.







Application Process



If you are interested:



- Send me your resume.

- Tell me about your background and experience with Physics.

- Briefly explain your experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT.



Applicants who appear to be a good fit will receive a small sample/test assignment.



If you complete the assignment accurately and follow the instructions well, we will schedule an online interview. During the interview, I will ask you to solve several Physics problems in real-time so I can evaluate your Physics knowledge.







Hours & Long-Term Opportunity



I expect approximately 5–15 hours of work per week for the next 4 months.



If we work well together, I would like this to become a longer-term position. Future work may include helping me:



- Develop complete Physics units.

- Build worksheets and activities.

- Review existing curriculum.

- Help develop complete Physics courses.



There is significant opportunity for increased responsibility for the right person.







Payment



Initial work will generally be paid per completed worksheet/project, with the expected compensation roughly equivalent to $5–$10 USD per hour, depending on the complexity of the work and your efficiency.



I am open to increasing the rate for someone who consistently produces excellent work, demonstrates strong Physics knowledge, and can take on more responsibility over time.

title: Real Estate VA - Warm Inbound Qualifying/Appt Setting
description:
Real Estate ISA / Lead Manager — Remote



We are looking for a confident, motivated, and highly organized Real Estate Inside Sales Agent (ISA) / Lead Manager to join our growing real estate team.



This is not a cold-calling position.



Our marketing team generates homeowner leads through outbound text campaigns. Your job begins once a homeowner responds and expresses some level of interest.



You will be responsible for responding to those leads via text, calling interested homeowners, qualifying their situation, nurturing longer-term opportunities inside our CRM, and ultimately booking qualified appointments for our sales team.



What You'll Be Doing



Inbound Lead Response



Respond quickly to homeowners who engage with our text campaigns

Have natural conversations via SMS to determine their level of interest

Identify qualified opportunities and move conversations toward a phone call

Follow up consistently with homeowners who stop responding



Phone Qualification



Call homeowners who have responded to our campaigns

Follow our provided qualification script and process

Build rapport and have natural, conversational interactions

Gather information about the property's condition and renovations

Understand the homeowner's motivation for potentially selling

Determine their expected selling timeline

Identify whether they are currently working with another Realtor or investor

Gather and verify all necessary contact information



Appointment Setting



Transition qualified homeowners into appointments with our local real estate brokers

Offer specific appointment times and overcome basic scheduling objections

Confirm the date, time, phone number, and
 address

Make sure appointments are properly entered into the CRM/calendar

Provide detailed notes so our sales team knows exactly what they're walking into



CRM & Lead Nurturing



Maintain accurate records for every lead

Update lead status, notes, motivation, timeline, property condition, and follow-up dates

Follow up with leads who aren't ready to sell immediately

Manage daily follow-up tasks

Re-engage older leads

Keep the pipeline organized and ensure no opportunity falls through the cracks

What We're Looking For



We want someone who is:



Fluent in conversational English

Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based homeowners

Confident and personable on the phone

Able to follow a script without sounding scripted

Naturally curious and good at asking follow-up questions

Comfortable handling objections and rejection

Organized and consistent with CRM follow-up

Able to communicate professionally through both phone and text

Self-motivated and able to work remotely without constant supervision

Focused on results and appointment generation



Previous experience as a Real Estate ISA, Lead Manager, Appointment Setter, or Sales Development Representative is strongly preferred.



Experience working with real estate investors, wholesalers, agents, or motivated seller leads is a major plus.



What We Provide



We will provide:



Lead flow

Calling scripts

Texting scripts

Qualification criteria

CRM access

Training

Lead follow-up processes

Appointment-setting framework

Ongoing coaching and feedback



You will not be expected to generate your own leads.



What Success Looks Like



Your job isn't simply to make calls.



Your job is to take a homeowner who has shown interest and move them through the pipeline:



Text Response → Conversation → Qualification → Appointment → Long-Term Follow-Up



Some homeowners will be ready to speak with us immediately.



Others may be 3, 6, or even 12+ months away from selling.



We expect you to recognize the difference and nurture those opportunities appropriately rather than throwing away leads that aren't ready today.



Compensation



Hourly/Base Pay + Performance Incentives



We are open to structuring compensation around experience, but there will be an opportunity to earn additional compensation based on qualified appointments and/or closed transactions generated from your pipeline.



We want someone who benefits financially when the team succeeds.



Schedule



Remote Position



You must be available during designated U.S. Eastern Time business hours and be able to respond quickly when new leads enter the system.



Specific hours will be discussed during the interview.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



Your previous experience with real estate, appointment setting, or inside sales

What CRMs you've worked with

Your experience handling SMS/text leads

Your experience speaking with U.S.-based prospects

Your availability in Eastern Time

A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be good at this position



Please begin your application with the words:



“REAL ESTATE ISA”



This lets us know you actually read the entire job description.



We're looking for someone who can become a long-term member of the team, learn our sales process, manage our lead pipeline, and consistently turn conversations into opportunities.

title: Strategic Projects & Implementation Manager
description:
Take an unclear business problem. Build the path. Drive it to completion. This role is for a high-agency operator who can turn CEO priorities into organized projects, coordinate the right people and resources, and get implementations finished.



THE OPPORTUNITY  

ABC Home Buyers is a lean Pennsylvania real estate investment company building the systems, people, and execution capacity needed to scale. We are hiring a Strategic Projects & Implementation Manager to sit between strategy and execution. The CEO will define the outcome and make major strategic decisions; you will determine how approved initiatives get organized, researched, staffed, and implemented.



This is not an Executive Assistant role, a task-following Project Coordinator role, or a full Operations Manager role. The value of this seat is turning ambiguity into structure and then driving the work through completion.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN  

• Convert priorities and unresolved business problems into clear projects with objectives, deliverables, owners, dependencies, timelines, and decision points.

• Research unfamiliar problems, compare approaches, gather missing information, and bring practical recommendations instead of open-ended questions.

• Source, screen, and coordinate vendors, freelancers, specialists, and internal support required for implementation.

• Drive projects through execution by tracking milestones, following up, resolving blockers, and keeping work from stalling.

• Build or improve workflows, SOPs, dashboards, CRM processes, templates, automations, and other business systems as projects require.

• Test, document, and hand off completed implementations so the result is actually usable in day-to-day operations.

• Bring CEO decisions in a concise format: problem, findings, options, tradeoffs, recommendation, and specific decision required.



MUST-HAVES  These are required to advance in the hiring process.

• Demonstrated experience taking an ambiguous project, business problem, or initiative from unclear starting point through implementation.

• Strong ownership and follow-through; able to move work forward without constant supervision, chasing, or step-by-step direction.

• Structured problem-solving and research ability; comfortable figuring out unfamiliar problems and making recommendations.

• Strong project execution across multiple people, dependencies, deadlines, follow-ups, and changing information.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to synthesize complexity into clear updates and decision packages.

• Sound judgment about what can be d
 independently versus what should be escalated to the CEO.

• Availability for approximately 20 hours/week with meaningful overlap during U.S. weekday business hours.



PREFERRED — NOT REQUIRED  

• Experience working directly with a founder, owner, or senior executive in a small or entrepreneurial business.

• Experience sourcing and managing vendors, freelancers, consultants, or specialists.

• Experience building or improving SOPs, workflows, dashboards, CRM/business systems, or light automations.

• Comfort with Google Workspace, project boards, AI/research tools, and modern business software.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE  

• CEO priorities move from vague idea/problem to a clear implementation plan without requiring the CEO to architect every step.

• Assigned projects progress predictably and reach the agreed definition of done rather than remaining partially built or perpetually in progress.

• Vendors, freelancers, specialists, and internal support are coordinated effectively without the CEO becoming their project manager.

• Completed implementations are tested, documented enough to operate, and handed off into day-to-day use.

• Problems and blockers surface early with analysis, options, and a recommended next action.



How to Apply

Submit: résumé/profile, a short note on your most relevant experience, and a 2-3 minute Loom/video or voice introduction. Describe one ambiguous project you personally took from unclear problem to completed implementation: the problem, your plan, what you coordinated, and the result.

title: Job Posting — Clinical & Patient Experience Coordinator
description:
Growing U.S.-based functional medicine telehealth practice specializing in hormone replacement therapy, peptides, GLP-1 weight loss, and root-cause longevity care. We are a premium, concierge-level practice scaling to high volume and expanding to an office location.



We are seeking a highly organized, medically experienced Clinical Operations & Patient Experience Coordinator to become the right hand of the provider — and a true backup to our existing Clinical Coordinator.



This is not an entry-level VA role.



This person must be able to do everything our current coordinator does, so that when she is out, the practice keeps running without a single missed call, missed refill, or dropped patient.



***You will also answer all calls and be the primary voice our patients hear on the phone.***



----



Who This Role Is For



You have:



• Experience working in a hormone clinic, wellness clinic, or functional medicine practice

• Medical assistant, nursing, or healthcare coordination background

• ***Strong written and spoken English with a clear, neutral accent — you will be the voice of our practice on every call***

• Experience using Optimantra EMR

• Experience managing prescriptions and pharmacy coordination (experience using LifeFile preferred)

• Confidence and warmth speaking with patients about pricing and services

• 2+ years of customer service or patient-facing phone experience



You are proactive, detail-oriented, and do not wait to be told what to do.



You stay calm with frustrated or confused patients and make them feel cared for.



---



Core Responsibilities



Patient Communication (your day-to-day priority)

• Answer all incoming patient calls live with a warm, professional, confident manner

• Return patient calls and follow up on messages

• Respond to non-clinical patient inquiries and answer pricing questions confidently and clearly

• Triage calls — route clinical/medical questions to the provider, handle all administrative questions yourself

• Capture every phone and message lead into our CRM (GoHighLevel)



EMR + Operations (full backup capability)

• Manage patient charts inside Optimantra

• Ensure labs, consents, and intake forms are complete before visits

• Scrub the schedule daily for compliance



Pharmacy Coordination

• Track and manage LifeFile pharmacy orders across multiple compounding pharmacies

• Monitor refill schedules

• Ensure no prescription lapses



Financial Coordination

• Create and manage invoices

• Track memberships and automatic billing

• Follow up on failed payments

• Send payment links and assist patients with completing payments



Administrative Support

• Maintain refill calendar

• Flag urgent issues to provider

• Ensure no patient falls through the cracks



You will be cross-trained by our existing Clinical Coordinator on every system and workflow she runs, so you can fully cover her role if she is out.



---



Requirements

• Minimum 2 years experience in a wellness, hormone, or functional medicine clinic

• ***Strong English (written + verbal) with a clear, neutral accent***

• Experience with EMR systems (Optimantra strongly preferred)

• Familiarity with peptides, TRT, GLP-1, and HRT

• Experience managing prescriptions and pharmacy coordination (LifeFile preferred)

• 2+ years customer service or patient-facing phone experience

• Warm, professional, patient, and empathetic phone manner

• Organized and detail-oriented

• Comfortable handling confidential medical information and willing to complete HIPAA training

• Reliable internet + quiet home office for live call answering

• Available full-time during US Eastern business hours (long-term)



---



Compensation

Competitive hourly rate based on experience.

Long-term position with opportunity to grow into Lead Operations role.



---



How to Apply

Please include:



A short audio recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself, your clinic experience, and why you'd be a great voice for a premium medical practice. Applications without an audio recording will not be considered — your phone voice is a core part of this role.



A brief summary of your medical or wellness clinic experience.

EMR systems you have used (Optimantra experience a plus).

Pharmacy coordination or LifeFile experience, if any.

Your available start date and confirmation that you can work US Eastern Time hours.

The word "Precision" in the subject line to confirm you read this fully.

title: Seasonal Outbound Call Agent
description:
Employment Type: Seasonal Contract (via Native Teams – Employer of Record)

Contract Duration: September 28, 2026 – December 15, 2026

Compensation: PHP 40,600 per month + Performance Incentives

Schedule:

September 28 – October 31: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (US Central Time)

November 1 – December 15: 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM (US Central Time)



About Marketplace Insurance Exchange



The Marketplace Insurance Exchange is committed to helping individuals and families maintain their health insurance coverage by providing exceptional service throughout the Open Enrollment period.



We're looking for three (3) Seasonal Outbound Call Agents to join our team during one of the busiest and most important times of the year.



If you enjoy helping people, communicating over the phone, and working toward measurable goals, we'd love to hear from you.





About the Role



This is not a sales position.



As a Seasonal Outbound Call Agent, your primary responsibility is to contact existing clients who have not yet completed their Open Enrollment forms and assist them in completing the required paperwork to help continue their health coverage.

You'll follow up with clients through phone calls, SMS, and WhatsApp while accurately documenting every interaction.



If a client has questions regarding insurance coverage or benefits, you'll escalate the matter to the appropriate internal team or designated insurance agent.



Key Responsibilities



- Contact existing clients with incomplete Open Enrollment forms.

- Assist clients in completing their enrollment forms during the call whenever possible.

- Conduct follow-up calls, SMS, and WhatsApp messages until the enrollment process is completed.

- Make approximately 100–150 outbound calls per day.

- Document all client interactions accurately in iAgencyPal CRM.

- Update shared Excel tracking sheets with notes and status updates.

- Coordinate with internal tea
mbers regarding client progress.

- Escalate complex inquiries to the appropriate tea
mber or insurance agent.

- Participate in daily team huddles and coaching sessions.



What This Role Does NOT Include



To set clear expectations, this position does not involve:

- Selling insurance products

- Recommending insurance plans

- Explaining policy benefits or coverage

- Providing licensed insurance advice



Your role is to assist clients in completing their required enrollment paperwork and connect them with the appropriate representative when necessary.



Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured through:

- 100–150 outbound calls per day per agent

- 15 completed enrollment forms per day per agent

- Accurate CRM documentation

- Timely follow-ups

- Reliable attendance and punctuality



Qualifications



We're looking for candidates with:

- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

- Previous experience in customer service, outbound calling, virtual assistance, administrative support, or a similar role.

- Strong phone etiquette and active listening skills.

- Basic Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets knowledge.

- Strong organizational and documentation skills.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection.

- A quiet work environment.

- A professional headset suitable for remote work.

- Experience in healthcare or insurance is an advantage but not required.



Tools You'll Use



- iAgencyPal CRM

- Nextiva Phone System

- Microsoft Teams

- Outlook

- Shared Excel Tracking Sheets

- WhatsApp



Training & Onboarding



Comprehensive training will be provided before you begin taking calls, training includes:

- Company Overview

- HIPAA & Data Privacy

- Open Enrollment Process

- iAgencyPal CRM

- Nextiva Phone System

- Call Scripts

- Documentation Standards



Training begins on September 28, 2026.



Compensation & Benefits



- PHP 40,600 monthly salary

- Performance incentive program

- Seasonal employment through Native Teams (Employer of Record)

- Company-issued laptop provided for the duration of the seasonal contract



(A company-issued laptop will be provided to successful candidates for use throughout the duration of the seasonal contract. The laptop remains the property of Marketplace Insurance Exchange and must be returned at the end of the engagement in accordance with company policies.)



Application Process



To be considered for this opportunity, please submit the following:



1. Updated Resume



2. Video Introduction (2–3 Minutes)

- Record a short video introducing yourself in English.

- In your video, please tell us:

Introduce yourself.

Briefly describe your professional background and relevant experience.

Tell us about your experience with customer service, outbound calling, virtual assistance, or administrative support.

Share why you're interested in this seasonal opportunity.

Explain why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.



3. Mock Outbound Call Recording

Please submit a separate voice recording using the following script:



Good morning/afternoon. May I please speak with [Client's Name]?

Hi [Client's Name], my name is [Your Name], and I'm calling on behalf of Marketplace Insurance Exchange.

I'm reaching out because we noticed that your Open Enrollment form hasn't been completed yet. I'd be happy to help you complete it today if you have a few minutes available.

Completing this form helps ensure we can continue assisting you with your health coverage.

If now isn't a convenient time, I'd be happy to schedule a callback at a time that works best for you.

If you have questions about your insurance coverage or benefits, I'll make sure your designated insurance agent contacts you as soon as possible.

Thank you for your time today. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to helping you complete your enrollment.



Join Our Team



This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a supportive, collaborative team during one of the most important campaigns of the year. If you're an excellent communicator who enjoys helping people and thrives in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help us make Open Enrollment a success!
