title: Technology and Automation Specialist
description:
The Technology and Automation Specialist will partner with the Technology and Automation team to advance the company's adoption and execution of AI-driven solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem, with a primary focus on the design, deployment, and ongoing management of Copilot agents and intelligent automation.



Working closely with the team, this role will collaborate on the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of AI solutions, Microsoft 365 optimization initiatives, and workflow automation projects that improve efficiency, enhance decision-making, and support organizational growth.



This is a fully remote position with competitive pay at $11 USD/hour. Standard hours are Monday–Thursday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST, and 8:00 AM–3:00 PM PST on Fridays. Contractors may extend Fridays to 5:00 PM PST.



Responsibilities

AI Strategy, Copilot Agents, and Intelligent Automation (Primary Focus):

- Design, build, deploy, and maintain companywide Copilot Agents that support core operational workflows, communication management, and decision-making

- Collaborate on the lifecycle of Copilot solutions, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement

- Identify and prioritize opportunities to embed AI into daily operations, reducing manual effort and improving speed and accuracy

- Develop and refine AI-driven workflows, including inbox monitoring,
 triage, and escalation of dormant or unaddressed communications

- Establish governance standards for Copilot usage, including prompt design, agent structure, data handling, and ongoing maintenance

- Evaluate emerging Microsoft AI capabilities and recommend scalable implementation strategies aligned with business needs



Microsoft Ecosystem Management and Automation (Secondary Focus):

- Oversee and optimize the company’s Microsoft 365 environment, including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, and the Power Platform

- Evaluate existing workflows and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and improved system utilization

- Design and implement Power Automate workflows to streamline operations and reduce manual tasks (in alignment with AI initiatives)

- Build systems to improve visibility and accountability, including dashboards, tracking tools, and reporting solutions using Power BI and Excel

- Partner with Leadership and Team Leads to assess operational pain points and recommend technology-driven solutions

- Establish and document best practices, governance standards, and system architecture across Microsoft tools



Adoption, Training, and Continuous Improvement:

- Provide guidance and training to staff on effective use of Microsoft tools, with emphasis on Copilot and AI-enabled workflows

- Drive adoption of AI and automation through practical, workflow-based use cases

- Troubleshoot system issues and continuously refine implemented solutions

- Stay current on Microsoft updates, AI advancements, and automation trends, proactively recommending enhancements

- Support special projects and system initiatives as needed



Required Skills and Abilities

- Advanced, hands-on experience designing and deploying Microsoft Copilot solutions and AI-driven workflows

- Strong experience building and maintaining AI agents, prompt frameworks, or automation using generative AI tools

- Deep experience with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint Migration Tool, MCP, webhooks, APIs and Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI) 

- Strong process improvement and workflow optimization mindset

- Ability to translate operational needs into scalable technical solutions

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

- Ability to work independently and proactively identify opportunities for improvement

- Strong written and verbal communication skills



Preferred Experience

- Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for inbox management, communication triage, or service operations

- Experience designing workflow-based AI use cases (e.g., escalation tracking, response monitoring, task routing)

- Experience supporting service-based or operations-driven organizations

- Experience working with shared inboxes, ticketing systems, or communication workflows

- Experience driving AI adoption across teams (not just building solutions)

- Experience working with remote or international teams



Education and Experience

- Degree in Information Technology, Machine Learning, or related field preferred

- Equivalent hands-on experience with Microsoft AI, Copilot, and automation tools may be considered in lieu of formal education



Work Arrangement

- Contract position (Philippines-based)

- Remote work environment

- Must be available for overlap with U.S. business hours as needed



Physical Requirements

- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer



Hardware & Internet Requirements

- PC required

- 16GB RAM or higher

- Intel® Core i3, AMD Ryzen 3 or higher processor 

- 256GB Solid State Drive (SSD) storage or larger

- Microsoft® Windows 11 Home Operating System

- Reliable 10 Mbps+ internet with backup connection and power

- Noise-canceling headset and high-quality webcam

 

Contractors

- Are not eligible for employee benefits such as paid time off (PTO), health insurance, or retirement plans, 

- Bill and are compensated only for hours worked, with no eligibility for overtime pay. The hourly rate remains consistent regardless of the number of hours worked, and

- Do not receive pay during company closures (e.g., holidays) unless they perform pre-approved work during those periods. We observe 14 holidays annually.



To reflect these differences, we are offering a higher hourly rate than that of a regular employee. This is intended to help offset costs such as health insurance and retirement and provide flexibility for unpaid time off.

•
 delivery issues (client + server side)

*** Must have excellent English writing and speaking skills and be comfortable supporting clients on the phone all day. ***

title: Senior Video Editor + Motion Graphics Artist needed for regular, ongoing work
description:
THE COMPANY

Avalon Creative Group is a well established and innovative content marketing agency based in the San Francisco Bay Area and Silicon Valley, California. We specialize in the creation of captivating and engaging content for corporate clients, offering comprehensive content design, production, and creative services. Working with Avalon is an exciting opportunity to join an award winning team of amazing designers, create content for renowned brands, and to expand your potential in a positive environment that encourages continuous learning for professional growth.



JOB DESCRIPTION

Avalon Creative Group is seeking a talented and experienced video editor and 3D animator based in the Philippines to work with us as an independent contractor. Our work includes videos to inspire audiences at corporate events, on-demand marketing webinars, internal corporate training and sales enablement, product demos, highlight reels, social media ads, interviews, customer testimonials and more. 



Our goal is to establish a long term working relationship with a creative, reliable and ambitious video professional. After successfully completing an initial trial period, the right person will become an integral member of our creative team on a full-time contract basis.



RESPONSIBILITIES

>>Edit high quality videos from a variety of sources, including single-camera, multi-camera, stock footage, AI generated video, graphic elements, music, sound effects, etc.

>>Effectively and efficiently generate video footage and elements using the latest AI tools

>>Manage accuracy and correction of color and audio

>>Understand and apply corporate branding and style guidelines and templates (MOGRTs)

>>Manage, organize and backup video assets and deliverables, including raw footage, graphics, sound files, stock footage, projects, files, etc.

>>Adhere to budgeted time constraints while incorporating client feedback and changes through multiple rounds of review and revisions

>>Contribute to and consistently apply efficient workflow processes and standards (SOPs)

>>Document guidelines and process details for team members and clients

>>Pursue ongoing professional development and skill enhancements



REQUIRED SKILLS

>>Expert level proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, centered around Premiere Pro and After Effects workflows

>>Proficiency in color correction, audio editing / mastering and video encoding

>>Demonstrated expertise in video editing fundamentals and techniques, including pacing, storytelling, and continuity

>>Excellent attention to detail and adeptness at managing multiple concurrent projects

>>Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote team environment

>>C2 (advanced/mastery) level proficiency in written and spoken English



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

>>At least 2 years of experience working full time as a video editor at a creative agency or in-house corporate video marketing team

>>At least 5 years of experience using Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects for professional, paid projects

>>A proven track record of punctuality, reliability and professionalism

>>Experience using a variety of AI post-production tools

>>Familiarity with team collaboration, communication and project management tools like ClickUp, Slack, Smartsheet, or similar platforms



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

>>Bachelor's degree in film making, visual communications or similar discipline

>>10 years of experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.

>>Strong understanding of visual composition, typography, and graphic design principles

>>Completion of training and/or certifications in Adobe Creative Suite applications

>>Knowledge of social media platforms and their video encoding specifications

>>Experience with 3D software like Blender, Cinema4D, or similar



ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

>>You must have strong creative skills and a portfolio of work that demonstrates your passion and experience with video editing, motion graphics and visual storytelling

>>Your portfolio must include examples of the type of work listed in the job description section

>>You must be based in the Philippines with fast, reliable internet access and a robust computer

>>You must have a quiet workspace where you can work without distractions and joining Zoom calls





COMPENSATION & ENGAGEMENT

>>This is a full-time, independent contractor and remote work position

>>Compensation rate will be between $1200 & $1600 USD per month

>>(A range of approximately ?73,800 to ?98,400 PHP per month as of Sun, Aug 16, 2026 PT)

>>Starting pay rate will be based on qualifications and experience

>>Total compensation includes:

>>Ten paid holidays per year

>>Ten days of accrued paid time off (PTO) per year

>>13th month pay and annual performance bonus paid every Dec after qualification period

>>Regular work schedule will be 9:00am to 6:00pm Pacific Time Zone

>>This is night shift in the Philippines



HOW TO APPLY If you are interested in working with us as an independent contractor and you meet the required qualifications listed above, please APPLY HERE -

title: Social Media Growth & Content Lead
description:
Lyons Cards + Journey Psyche | Remote | Full-Time



Two Brands — Two Different Audiences



This role supports two businesses:



Lyons Cards

Sports cards, collectibles, live commerce, breaks, Market Lab research, portfolio management and audience growth.



Journey Psyche

A multi-state mental-health/psychiatry company. Content may include educational posts, provider announcements, hiring campaigns, service information, market expansion, patient-access information and professional healthcare communications.



The successful candidate must be able to switch tone and strategy between the two brands.



For Lyons Cards, content should be energetic, fast-moving, entertaining and growth-focused.



For Journey Psyche, content should be polished, professional, accurate and appropriate for a healthcare organization.



Journey Psyche Responsibilities



* Publish and manage
, Instagram, LinkedIn and other applicable Journey Psyche channels

* Create and schedule healthcare-appropriate content

* Support provider recruiting and employment campaigns

* Publish provider introductions and market-expansion announcements

* Promote educational mental-health content

* Support paid Meta and LinkedIn recruiting/awareness campaigns

* Maintain consistent brand presentation across pages

* Coordinate website/social links and landing pages

* Use ChatGPT Business to help develop drafts, captions, campaign concepts and content plans

* Work from approved clinical/business information rather than improvising medical claims

* Protect patient privacy and never publish PHI or identifiable patient information

* Understand that healthcare content requires a higher level of review and accuracy than entertainment content



What Success Looks Like Across Both Brands



For Lyons Cards, success means:

followers, engagement, traffic, live-show viewers, leads and sales opportunities.



For Journey Psyche, success means:

qualified applicants, provider awareness, patient-access visibility, professional credibility, engagement and clean execution of approved campaigns.



The Person We Need



This is important wording for the ad:



We are not hiring someone to simply “post on social media.”



We are hiring someone who can take ownership of digital execution across two growing companies, understand the objective behind each campaign, work with existing creative resources and AI tools, and produce measurable results.



And I’d add one screening question specifically for this:



“How would you approach content differently for a sports-card/live-commerce brand versus a multi-state psychiatry company?”

title: Online Retail Operations Coordinator
description:
We’re looking for a highly proactive and organized Online Retail Operations Coordinator to become a key support partner for a growing consumer brand company.



This role is ideal for someone who can manage retail operations and inventory while also improving the systems and processes behind them. You’ll work across purchase orders, inventory, distributors, retailers, product information, and fulfillment, while using AI and automation to make the business more efficient.



You’ll also support retailer outreach and business development, helping build and improve the process of finding, contacting, and following up with potential retail accounts.



What You’ll Do 

- Manage purchase orders, inventory, SKUs, and product information across multiple brands and retail accounts

- Track incoming POs, inventory levels, supplier lead times, and fulfillment to identify potential shortages, delays, or other issues

- Coordinate with manufacturers, distributors, retailers, vendors, and shipping partners to keep orders accurate and on schedule

- Prepare and maintain operational documentation including POs, invoices, packing lists, BOLs, and shipping records

- Support new product setup, retailer submissions, and product/sample coordination

- Maintain accurate operational trackers and records across products, distributors, and retail accounts

- Identify inefficient processes and build or improve workflows, trackers, checklists, and systems

- Use Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to analyze information, solve operational problems, and automate repetitive tasks

- Research potential retail accounts, buyers, category managers, and retailer contacts

- Support retailer outreach through cold
, LinkedIn, and follow-ups

- Use tools such as Instantly, Apollo, or similar platforms to organize and improve outbound outreach

- Use Canva and AI-assisted design tools to create or update simple packaging, product assets, and social media content based on existing brand direction

- Handle ad hoc operational tasks and identify opportunities to improve day-to-day business processes



What We’re Looking For

- Experience in retail operations, e-commerce operations, inventory, purchasing, supply chain, or a similar operations role

- Hands-on experience with purchase orders, inventory, SKUs, and fulfillment

- Experience coordinating with retailers, distributors, manufacturers, vendors, or other external partners; consumer product experience is a plus

- Strong ability to manage complex operational information and multiple moving parts while maintaining accuracy

- Strong problem-solving and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to create structure when processes or systems are not already established

- Highly comfortable using AI tools, especially Claude or ChatGPT, to improve workflows and solve operational problems

- Experience supporting retailer outreach, lead generation, cold
, LinkedIn outreach, or sales development; Instantly, Apollo, or similar tool experience is a plus

- Comfortable using Canva and AI-assisted design tools for simple packaging, product, and social media updates

- Experience with inventory forecasting, replenishment, EDI, SPS Commerce, or retailer portals is a plus

- Comfortable learning new tools and working independently in a startup or fast-growing environment

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills

- Must have a stable internet connection and reliable work setup

- Must be available to work during US Eastern Time business hours



Salary and Benefits:

- Base salary: 55,000 PHP per month

- Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

- 100% Work From Home

title: Operations Specialist
description:
We're looking for an Operations Specialist who enjoys bringing structure to fast-moving operations and solving problems before they become bigger issues.



This isn't a role where you simply follow a checklist. You'll work directly with leadership to coordinate day-to-day operations, manage work orders, support client accounts, improve internal processes, and keep teams aligned across multiple moving pieces.



The ideal person is highly organized, communicates exceptionally well, takes ownership without waiting to be asked, and enjoys working in an environment where priorities evolve as the business grows.



Responsibilities 

- Create, manage, and maintain work orders in our proprietary operations platform using information gathered from client
s, phone calls, Slack conversations, and other communication channels.

- Translate complex or incomplete information into clear, accurate work orders by organizing task instructions, schedules, inventory details, and operator assignments.

- Monitor active and overdue work daily, proactively identify potential delays or SLA risks, and follow up with field operators to keep projects on track.

- Coordinate with clients, account managers, and field operators to communicate updates, confirm schedules, resolve operational issues, and ensure successful execution.

- Support new client onboarding by configuring work order types, workflows, and operational processes within the platform.

- Prepare structured daily reports for leadership, including operational priorities, active work, risks, blockers, and progress updates.

- Develop and maintain SOPs, onboarding guides, and internal knowledge base documentation to support consistent and scalable operations.

- Identify workflow gaps, recommend process improvements, and help build repeatable systems that improve operational efficiency as the business grows.

- Take ownership of day-to-day operational responsibilities while adapting quickly to changing priorities in a fast-paced startup environment.



Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in operations, operations coordination, account coordination, project coordination, dispatch support, logistics, customer operations, or a related field.

- 1+  year of experience working in a remote or work-from-home setup

- Previous startup experience is highly preferred.

- Experience supporting multiple stakeholders, client accounts, or cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

- Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy across multiple moving priorities.

- Excellent written communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with clients, operators, and internal teams.

- Ability to analyze information from
s, Slack conversations, meetings, or other communication channels and turn it into structured, actionable work.

- Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently, proactively solve problems, and adapt to changing priorities without constant direction.

- Experience creating or improving SOPs, onboarding documentation, and operational processes.

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Airtable, Asana, or similar collaboration tools.

- Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to improve productivity and operational efficiency.

- Must have a stable internet connection and a reliable workspace.

- Available to work US business hours



Salary and Benefits:

- Base salary: 55,000 PHP per month

- 100% remote / work-from-home

- PTO and paid holidays

title: Staffing Operations Specialist
description:
We're looking for a Staffing Operations Specialist to join an early-stage security technology startup as their first offshore operations hire.



This company uses technology to make it easier for businesses to access and manage security services. This role will help make sure staffing requests are handled quickly, shifts are fulfilled, and both workers and clients have the support they need.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with people, solving problems, and moving quickly. You'll manage daily staffing operations, coordinate workers and schedules, support clients, and help keep operations running smoothly.



As their first offshore operations hire, you'll have a lot of ownership and a direct impact on the overall business. You'll be trained on their systems and processes, but you'll also be expected to take initiative, make decisions, work independently, and take things and run with them.



What You'll Do

- Manage daily staffing operations, including schedules, shift fulfillment, and last-minute coverage.

- Coordinate with workers and partners to make sure staffing requests are fulfilled accurately and on time.

- Communicate with workers to coordinate shifts, answer questions, and resolve issues.

- Communicate with clients about staffing needs, schedule changes, and operational issues.

- Help onboard new workers and ensure they are ready for their assignments.

- Monitor daily operations and quickly address issues as they come up.

- Manage internal communications and make sure important information gets to the right people quickly.

- Identify operational problems and find practical ways to improve processes.

- Give feedback to the product and engineering team when something isn't working or could be improved.

- Use Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to solve problems, improve workflows, and work more efficiently.

- Take on different responsibilities as the company grows.



What We're Looking For 

- 2+ years of experience in staffing, workforce management, or operations, ideally in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience coordinating shifts, schedules, workers, or real-time staffing needs.

- Experience working with U.S.-based clients, workers, or operations is highly preferred.

- Previous startup experience is a strong plus.

- Comfortable communicating directly with both clients and workers.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle issues quickly as they come up.

- Able to work independently, take ownership, and make decisions without needing constant direction.

- Flexible and comfortable taking on different types of work as priorities change.
